items.title: França foi ameaçada por ataques híbridos russos nas últimas semanas, afirma Macron
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A França foi ameaçada por ataques híbridos russos nas últimas semanas, afirmou o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
A França foi ameaçada por ataques híbridos russos nas últimas semanas, afirmou o presidente francês, Emmanuel Macron, nesta sexta-feira.
“Nas últimas semanas, a ameaça — especialmente a ameaça híbrida russa — que paira sobre os europeus e a França se intensificou”, disse Macron a repórteres após se reunir em Paris com líderes de partidos políticos para discutir os recentes desdobramentos da situação internacional.

items.title: Precios récord del diésel en EEUU golpean a agricultores; valor de los alimentos podría subir
items.author: Leah Douglas, Lisa Baertlein, Nichola Groom
items.creator: Leah Douglas, Lisa Baertlein, Nichola Groom
items.summary: En el noreste de Misuri, Addie Yoder, una ganadera y productora de maíz y soja, maneja dos cosechadoras, tres camiones articulados y varios tractores desde mediados de septiembre hasta finales de octubre para cosechar y transportar sus cultivos.
items.body:
En el noreste de Misuri, Addie Yoder, una ganadera y productora de maíz y soja, maneja dos cosechadoras, tres camiones articulados y varios tractores desde mediados de septiembre hasta finales de octubre para cosechar y transportar sus cultivos.
Con los precios del diésel en máximos históricos y teniendo en cuenta que una sola cosechadora consume 300 galones de combustible, lo mejor que puede hacer es intentar reducir otros gastos, según explica.
En el sureste de Dakota del Sur, Drew Peterson, un ganadero y productor de soja y maíz, prevé gastar hasta 1.500 dólares al día solo en combustible para una de sus cosechadoras esta temporada, el doble de lo que le costó el año pasado, entre las muchas máquinas que debe utilizar para recoger su cosecha.
"No puedes limitarte a decir: 'Bueno, el diésel es caro, pues no voy a cosechar'", afirmó. "Simplemente tienes que hacer que encaje en tu presupuesto".
En todo Estados Unidos, los agricultores se enfrentan a precios récord del diésel en pleno apogeo de la temporada de cosecha, lo que reduce aún más unos márgenes ya de por sí ajustados. Las subidas de precios parecen inevitables en los supermercados estadounidenses de cara a las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre, en las que se espera que el costo de la vida sea una de las principales preocupaciones de los votantes.
El suministro mundial de combustible se ha visto reducido por la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán y los ataques ucranianos a las refinerías rusas. El precio promedio del diésel en Estados Unidos alcanzó esta semana un nuevo récord, 6,29 dólares por galón, lo que supone un aumento del 68% respecto a los 3,74 dólares de hace un año, según datos de la Administración de Información de Energía (EIA).
El aumento de los precios del diésel eleva los costos en todas las etapas de la cadena de suministro alimentario, desde la cosecha en las granjas hasta el transporte de mercancías que lleva los alimentos a los supermercados, explicó David Ortega, economista de la Universidad Estatal de Míchigan.
"La mayor parte de nuestros alimentos se transporta en camiones y esos camiones utilizan diésel", señaló Ortega.
Los precios al consumo de los alimentos subieron un 2,7% interanual en agosto, según el último Índice de Precios al Consumo.
LOS PRECIOS DEL COMBUSTIBLE SE DUPLICAN Los agricultores tienen acceso al diésel para uso no viario, que no está sujeto a impuestos estatales ni federales. Pero, incluso con ese descuento, muchos agricultores siguen pagando por el combustible una cantidad significativamente superior a la del año pasado.
Wayne Gularte, que cultiva diversas hortalizas en unos 600 acres cerca de Gonzales, California, dijo que sus gastos en combustible han aumentado alrededor de un 40%, pasando de unos 5 dólares por galón a 7 dólares por galón.
Para ahorrar en costos, ha vuelto a poner en servicio algunos tractores antiguos de gasolina de la década de 1950 y ha dejado fuera de servicio una de las camionetas diésel de la granja. "El único dinero que podemos ganar es el que ahorramos", afirmó Gularte.
Los costos de combustible en las granjas han aumentado 11 dólares por acre con respecto al año pasado en el caso del maíz y 7 dólares por acre en el de la soja, según Michael Langemeier, economista de la Universidad de Purdue.
Los futuros del maíz, la soja y el trigo se han recuperado significativamente desde mediados de agosto y alcanzaron máximos de varios años a principios de septiembre. Aun así, los márgenes de los agricultores siguen siendo escasos en comparación con los promedios históricos, señaló el economista agrícola de la Universidad de Illinois Nick Paulson, quien advirtió de que los elevados precios del combustible podrían aumentar los costos de las semillas y los fertilizantes el próximo año.
"La preocupación es que el precio del diésel, de más de 6 dólares por galón, empiece a ejercer presiones inflacionarias sobre todo lo demás, e incluso sobre parte de ese mayor potencial de rentabilidad", dijo.
Muchos agricultores ya se han apretado el cinturón, lo que les deja poco margen para hacer frente a las subidas del precio del combustible, señaló Jon Paul Driver, productor de heno cerca de Spokane, Washington, y segundo vicepresidente de la Washington Farm Bureau.
"Cualquier subida del combustible en este momento supone una deuda adicional para la explotación", señaló Driver.
El senador estadounidense Roger Marshall, republicano por Kansas, solicitó a la secretaria de Agricultura, Brooke Rollins, en una carta del 11 de septiembre, que proporcionara un alivio temporal a los agricultores, ya que estos "absorben importantes costos de combustible no previstos durante uno de los periodos del año en los que más se consume diésel".
Un portavoz del Departamento de Agricultura de Estados Unidos (USDA) dijo que la agencia "no está dejando piedra sin remover" en lo que respecta a los elevados precios del diésel y se refirió a una entrevista concedida a NewsMax el 15 de septiembre, en la que Rollins señaló que tendría más novedades que anunciar sobre el tema en las próximas semanas.
LOS PRECIOS DE LOS ALIMENTOS PODRÍAN AUMENTAR Aunque el combustible representa una pequeña parte del costo de los alimentos, los consumidores podrían ver cómo suben los precios a medida que la cadena de suministro absorba los mayores costos del combustible en los próximos meses, señaló Ortega.
Esos efectos podrían tardar en manifestarse, ya que los minoristas podrían intentar absorber los aumentos de precios a corto plazo, o porque los contratos de transporte fijados a precios más bajos aún no reflejan los recargos por combustible, explicó Ortega.
Añadió que algunos de los productos más vulnerables a las subidas de precios son los alimentos básicos, como las frutas y verduras, los lácteos y la carne, que requieren un transporte en camiones frigoríficos con un elevado consumo de combustible.
Las tarifas para transportar manzanas y peras en camiones frigoríficos desde el valle de Yakima, en el estado de Washington, han alcanzado su máximo en cuatro años cuando la temporada de cosecha apenas va por la mitad, según Dean Croke, analista principal de DAT Freight & Analytics.
El costo del transporte de productos agrícolas desde California ha aumentado entre un 40% y un 120% con respecto al año pasado. En algunas ciudades de California, los precios del diésel han superado los 8 dólares por galón, señaló Croke.
Los transportistas independientes, que suelen pagar el combustible por adelantado, podrían no ser capaces de soportar nuevas subidas, señaló Croke.
"Estamos a punto de asistir a quiebras de empresas de transporte provocadas por el precio del diésel", afirmó.

items.title: Produção manufatureira dos EUA cai em agosto após sete meses de alta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A produção nas fábricas dos Estados Unidos caiu inesperadamente em agosto, após sete meses consecutivos de alta, mas a atividade continua sendo sustentada pela expansão dos investimentos em inteligência artificial.
items.body:
A produção nas fábricas dos Estados Unidos caiu inesperadamente em agosto, após sete meses consecutivos de alta, mas a atividade continua sendo sustentada pela expansão dos investimentos em inteligência artificial.
A produção manufatureira teve queda de 0,3% no mês passado, após um aumento não revisado de 0,2% em julho, informou o Federal Reserve nesta sexta-feira.
Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam um aumento de 0,3% na produção. Em agosto, a produção registrou um crescimento de 0,9% em relação ao mesmo mês do ano anterior.
(Reportagem de Lucia Mutikani)

items.title: Ceuta border crisis fuels EUs far right despite fall in migrant arrivals, commissioner says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Images of migrants crossing into Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta have fuelled support for far-right parties despite a sharp decline in irregular arrivals in Europe following tougher migration policies, EU Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner said on Friday.
items.body:
Images of migrants crossing into Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta have fuelled support for far-right parties despite a sharp decline in irregular arrivals in Europe following tougher migration policies, EU Migration Commissioner Magnus Brunner said on Friday.
[USN:L1N43X0ZO TEXT:"More than 72,000 people surged into"] the enclave from Morocco at the end of July, although most later left. Spain estimates 12,000 migrants remain in the tiny territory, including minors.
"We have the decreasing numbers, but images from Ceuta, of course, overshadow the actual successes and the actual facts and figures," Brunner told Reuters in an interview.
He said these images "fuel the far right", which was why "it is so important to return those people as soon as possible to show that we have control."
Asked about Commission President Ursula von der Leyen's proposal on Wednesday for an [USN:S8N4150LX TEXT:"emergency framework to prevent"] "engineered and weaponised" mass movements of migrants, Brunner said the details would be discussed at the next EU Council meeting of member states. But "first of all, we have to implement the system we already agreed on," he added.
Anti-immigration sentiment has remained a potent political force across Europe since more than 1 million people, many of them Syrians fleeing war, arrived in the bloc in 2015. The surge has helped boost support for nationalist and far-right parties and pushed many governments towards tougher migration policies focused on deterrence and returns.
Brunner also defended the European Commission's decision to facilitate talks between EU member states and [USN:L8N42V132 TEXT:"Taliban officials, as governments seek ways to return Afghans"] convicted of crimes in Europe. Rights groups criticised the move, saying it lent legitimacy to Afghanistan's Islamist rulers, put Afghans at risk and undermined core EU values.
"I think first and foremost, it's about European security and the security of the European citizens," Brunner said when asked how the bloc could ensure that deportees sent to Afghanistan would not face persecution or harm.

items.title: Fed's Bowman says changes to bank stress test coming soon
items.author: Pete Schroeder
items.creator: Pete Schroeder
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's top regulatory official said on Friday that an overhaul of the US central bank's "stress test" of big banks will make the process more transparent and the results more predictable for lenders, handing the industry long-sought reforms to the exam process.
items.body:
The Federal Reserve's top regulatory official said on Friday that an overhaul of the US central bank's "stress test" of big banks will make the process more transparent and the results more predictable for lenders, handing the industry long-sought reforms to the exam process.
Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said in prepared remarks to an event in London that the central bank will consider a final version of the revamped exam in the "coming weeks" which she said would "finally close the book on an opaque and unnecessarily unpredictable framework."
Banks have complained for years that the Fed's stress tests, put in place following the 2008 financial crisis and used to set additional capital requirements for the nation's largest lenders, are subjective and onerous. The industry sued the Fed in 2024 to challenge the use of the tests, and the central bank under Bowman put forward [USN:L6N3W40Z7 TEXT:"a series of proposed changes"] in October.
On Friday, Bowman said the new version of the test will shed far more light on the models the Fed uses to probe banks for weaknesses, including various equations, variables, and other technical details the central bank long kept secret from the industry. The new process will also provide more details on the hypothetical economic scenarios created each year for the test, changes Bowman said will allow the public greater understanding of the testing process.
The Fed also plans to adopt a new rule that would average the results of a bank's two most recent stress tests when assigning capital requirements known as the "stress capital buffer." Bowman said this approach will reduce volatility in the capital that banks must set aside each year.
Going forward, Bowman said the public will be able to comment on the testing models, and the Fed intends to use its stress testing process to help privately inform supervisors of potential bank weaknesses. She added that banks are already conducting multiple internal stress tests on their own, and examiners and banks should have "open dialogue" on any relevant findings.
"I believe there is tremendous value in comparing notes," she said.
items.raw_description: The Federal Reserve's top regulatory official said on Friday that an overhaul of the US central bank's "stress test" of big banks will make the process more transparent and the results more predictable for lenders, handing the industry long-sought reforms to the exam process.

items.title: Ministro italiano de Defensa pide más buques para proteger la navegación en el Mar Rojo
items.author: Angelo Amante
items.creator: Angelo Amante
items.summary: El ministro de Defensa de Italia pidió este viernes una mayor presencia naval en el Mar Rojo para proteger la navegación mercante, ante la preocupación que suscita el estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, una vía navegable vital amenazada por el conflicto en Oriente Medio, que no deja de extenderse.
items.body:
El ministro de Defensa de Italia pidió este viernes una mayor presencia naval en el Mar Rojo para proteger la navegación mercante, ante la preocupación que suscita el estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb, una vía navegable vital amenazada por el conflicto en Oriente Medio, que no deja de extenderse.
Los hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán, han avanzado rápidamente en las últimas semanas a lo largo de la costa del Mar Rojo, lo que complica aún más las rutas en una región que también incluye el estrecho de Ormuz, donde el tráfico ya se había reducido debido a la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán.
Italia, que forma parte de la misión "Aspides" de la Unión Europea —puesta en marcha en 2024 para proteger la navegación de los ataques hutíes—, anunció el jueves que estaba preparando una misión naval en la zona, alegando que no podía esperar a que la UE respondiera a la nueva crisis.
"Tras mis declaraciones, se ha movido algo dentro de Aspides, pero necesitamos más buques", declaró a Reuters el ministro de Defensa, Guido Crosetto, uno de los principales aliados de la primera ministra Giorgia Meloni.
"Los únicos países que realmente apoyan (las iniciativas de seguridad) son Italia y Grecia", añadió, sin querer dar una cifra aproximada de cuántos buques se necesitarían para garantizar la seguridad de la zona.
"LA BUROCRACIA EUROPEA" El estrecho de Bab el-Mandeb tiene 29 kilómetros de ancho en su punto más estrecho y es una de las rutas marítimas más importantes del mundo, por la que se transportan mercancías y materias primas desde Asia a Europa a través del canal de Suez.
Según la empresa de datos y análisis de materias primas Kpler, los volúmenes de petróleo que transitaron por Bab el-Mandeb representaron alrededor del 7% de la producción mundial de petróleo en junio.
Assarmatori, una de las principales asociaciones que representan a los armadores italianos, señaló que alrededor del 40% del comercio de Italia con el resto del mundo pasa por el Canal de Suez.
El jueves, Crosetto afirmó que Roma había decidido actuar con su Armada porque no quería que la respuesta se viera frenada por lo que él denominó "burocracia europea", y advirtió de que los retrasos podrían agravar la situación.
Roma no ha detallado qué medidas está barajando ni qué recursos navales podría enviar a la zona.

items.title: Argentina anota superávit fiscal primario por unos 1.319 mln dlr en agosto
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Argentina contabilizó un superávit fiscal primario (SPN) de 1,99 billones de pesos (unos 1.319 millones de dólares) en agosto, reportó el martes el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo, en su cuenta de X.
items.body:
Argentina contabilizó un superávit fiscal primario (SPN) de 1,99 billones de pesos (unos 1.319 millones de dólares) en agosto, reportó el martes el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo, en su cuenta de X.
El resultado financiero del octavo mes del 2026 alcanzó un saldo positivo de 635.529 millones de pesos, con un incremento interanual del 62,8%.
"El orden fiscal (del Gobierno) se alcanzó mediante la reducción del gasto público, habiendo llevado adelante en simultáneo una reducción de impuestos acumulada equivalente a alrededor de 3% del PIB", dijo el funcionario.
Durante agosto, el pago de intereses netos de tenencias intra sector público alcanzó los 1,35 billones de pesos.
De esta manera, en los primeros ocho meses del año, el SPN acumuló un superávit primario de aproximadamente el 1,1% del PIB y un superávit financiero en torno al 0,2% del PIB.
"Tal como prevé el proyecto de Presupuesto 2027, el SPN alcanzará el año que viene un superávit financiero cumpliendo con todas sus obligaciones por cuarto ejercicio consecutivo, algo inédito en la historia del país", sostuvo Caputo.
- Cambio a fin de agosto: 1 dólar = 1.509 pesos

items.title: Rangers eager to rebound in opener of crucial series vs. Jays
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Two teams that are in the thick of the American League playoff hunt will meet Friday night when the Toronto Blue Jays and Texas Rangers open a three-game series in Arlington, Texas.
items.body:
Two teams that are in the thick of the American League playoff hunt will meet Friday night when the Toronto Blue Jays and Texas Rangers open a three-game series in Arlington, Texas.
The Rangers (76-77) and Blue Jays (76-77) are among the teams battling for a wild-card spot. Both teams trail the Cleveland Guardians by two games in the race for the final berth.
Texas also is in the AL West race but fell a game behind Houston at the top of the division with Thursday's 4-3 loss to Boston.
The Rangers looked as if they might complete a three-game sweep of the Red Sox until closer Jacob Latz gave up a three-run homer to Trevor Story in the eighth inning that handed Boston a 4-3 lead. The loss ended the Rangers' four-game winning streak.
Texas manager Skip Schumaker said Latz was available for only one inning. He sent him to the mound after Jakob Junis put the first two hitters on base in the eighth.
"Wasn't gonna wait any longer," Schumaker said. "So Latz did a good job against (Adley) Rutschman (for the first out of the inning) and unfortunately gave up a home run. Again, I said it before, if we were gonna lose, I'd rather lose with our best guys, and we did -- and that's OK. It's part of the game.
"Just trying to figure out the right kind of recipe to get it into Latz's hands so we don't have to use him in the eighth inning. Trying to not use Latz multi-innings, or use him in the eighth and figure out the ninth later. (Robert) Garcia was down today. So few guys in the back end. We would have closed with (Trevor) Williams and (Jordan Montgomery) if Latz could have gotten through that inning."
Meanwhile, Max Scherzer held Detroit to one run on three hits in five innings during Toronto's 5-1 victory Wednesday to collect his second win in his last four starts.
The Blue Jays were idle on Thursday.
"We have work to do," Scherzer said. "It takes all of us, not only the starting staff, but the bullpen, the hitters. We have to win ballgames. Our backs are against the wall. We've got to come out fighting and clawing, and keep finding ways to win ballgames.
"It's great when you have to come to the field, and it's must-win baseball. That's how we've felt for a while now. We know this position that we're in. We're aware of the standings, but at the end of the day, you've got to come here and win ball games."
Texas and Toronto each have nine games left in the regular season.
"We'll try to go 1-0 every day," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said on Wednesday. "That's it. It's going to be another tough series. It will be a good off-day for everyone (Thursday), but every day and every series is going to be tough and really important."
Right-hander Dylan Cease (11-5, 2.38 ERA) will start for Toronto on Friday. Cease is 3-3 with a 6.19 ERA in eight career appearances (all starts) against the Rangers. He allowed four runs on four hits and struck out 10 batters in 4 2/3 innings in a 7-4 loss to them on June 27.
Right-hander Kumar Rocker (5-11, 4.54 ERA) is Texas' probable starter for the series opener.
Rocker is 0-1 with a 1.00 ERA against Toronto in two career appearances, both starts. He scattered four hits over six scoreless innings in a no-decision vs. the Blue Jays on June 28.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Warren Buffett deja el cargo de presidente de Berkshire y su hijo Howard le sucede
items.author: Manya Saini, Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Manya Saini, Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway anunció el viernes que Warren Buffett dejará su cargo de presidente y pasará a ser presidente emérito, con efecto inmediato, nueve meses después de ceder el mando de la dirección ejecutiva a su mano derecha desde hace mucho tiempo, Greg Abel.
items.body:
Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) anunció el viernes que Warren Buffett dejará su cargo de presidente y pasará a ser presidente emérito, con efecto inmediato, nueve meses después de ceder el mando de la dirección ejecutiva a su mano derecha desde hace mucho tiempo, Greg Abel.
La empresa nombró presidente a su hijo, Howard Buffett, director desde 1993.
A Warren Buffett se le atribuye haber transformado Berkshire de una empresa textil en quiebra en un conglomerado de 1,1 billones de dólares, al tiempo que desarrolló una filosofía de inversión que ha influido en generaciones de inversores y ejecutivos, lo que le ha convertido en una de las figuras más influyentes del mundo empresarial estadounidense moderno.
Las acciones serie B de Berkshire registraban una caída del 0,3% en las operaciones previas a la apertura del mercado. La reputación de Buffett también se ha reflejado en la valoración de la empresa, ya que los inversores llevan años atribuyendo una "prima de Buffett" a sus acciones.
La relación precio-valor contable del conglomerado ha caído desde que Buffett anunciara que dejaría el cargo de presidente ejecutivo, pasando de alrededor de 1,62 a 1,53, según datos recopilados por LSEG.
Berkshire sigue siendo la única compañía financiera en el club de las empresas con un valor de mercado de un billón de dólares, dominado por los gigantes tecnológicos.
"Siempre fue una cuestión de cuándo, no de si. Buffett ha llevado a cabo una salida con elegancia", dijo Brian Jacobsen, estratega económico jefe de Annex Wealth Management. "Berkshire ha tenido años para prepararse para esta transición, por lo que esto parece más la culminación de una sucesión cuidadosamente planificada que un cambio de guardia repentino".
"El tiempo siempre gana. Sin embargo, ha sido generoso conmigo", escribió el viernes Buffett, de 96 años, que lleva en Berkshire desde 1965, en una carta a los accionistas.
La influencia de Buffett se ha extendido mucho más allá de Berkshire, marcando a generaciones de líderes empresariales e inversores con su énfasis en el pensamiento a largo plazo, la asignación disciplinada del capital y una gestión sencilla.
"La cultura que Warren construyó y los valores que defendió seguirán siendo el corazón de Berkshire, y Howard será su guardián", dijo Abel en un comunicado el viernes.
Los presidentes ejecutivos han recurrido a Buffett como consejero en todo tipo de asuntos, desde adquisiciones y sucesiones hasta cómo capear períodos de turbulencias en los mercados, mientras que sus juntas anuales de accionistas se convirtieron en un punto de encuentro para los inversores.
"Como presidente emérito, el señor Buffett seguirá siendo miembro del directorio y continuará ofreciendo su valioso criterio y perspectiva", señaló Berkshire en un comunicado. El título de presidente emérito suele ser un título honorífico que se otorga a un ejecutivo jubilado del directorio o al fundador de una empresa para reconocer sus servicios prestados y su impacto duradero.
Buffett anunció por primera vez sus planes de retirarse del conglomerado en mayo de 2025, lo que sorprendió a accionistas y analistas a pesar de su edad. Tras décadas al frente de la empresa, se había convertido en sinónimo de la misma, lo que hizo que su sucesión fuera una de las más seguidas en el mundo empresarial estadounidense.
Entre los negocios de Berkshire se incluyen la aseguradora de automóviles Geico, la compañía ferroviaria BNSF, numerosas empresas energéticas e industriales, la marca de helados Dairy Queen y marcas de larga tradición como la World Book Encyclopedia. También posee cientos de miles de millones de dólares en acciones y bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos.

items.title: Investor Petrus stellt sich nach Shortseller-Vorwürfen hinter RBI
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Der Investor Petrus Advisers hat das österreichische Geldhaus Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) gegen die Vorwürfe des Leerverkäufers Grizzly Research in Schutz genommen. Dessen Bericht sei "faktenarm, schlecht recherchiert und substanzlos", teilte Petrus Advisers am Freitag mit. Er stütze sich auf russische Zolldaten, die jedoch keine Beweise für Sanktionsverstöße lieferten. "Unterstellung ist kein Beweis". Zudem verwies der Investor auf einen ähnlichen Vorfall vom Februar 2025, nach dem sich die Aktie rasch erholt habe. Der britische Investor erklärte zudem, am Donnerstag RBI-Aktien erworben zu haben, und behielt sich rechtliche Schritte vor.
items.body:
Der Investor Petrus Advisers hat das österreichische Geldhaus Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) (RBIV.VI) gegen die Vorwürfe des Leerverkäufers Grizzly Research in Schutz genommen. Dessen Bericht sei "faktenarm, schlecht recherchiert und substanzlos", teilte Petrus Advisers am Freitag mit. Er stütze sich auf russische Zolldaten, die jedoch keine Beweise für Sanktionsverstöße lieferten. "Unterstellung ist kein Beweis". Zudem verwies der Investor auf einen ähnlichen Vorfall vom Februar 2025, nach dem sich die Aktie rasch erholt habe. Der britische Investor erklärte zudem, am Donnerstag RBI-Aktien erworben zu haben, und behielt sich rechtliche Schritte vor.
Der am Donnerstag veröffentlichte Bericht hatte die RBI-Aktie zunächst auf Talfahrt geschickt. Das Papier verlor in der Spitze mehr als neun Prozent, notierte am Freitagnachmittag jedoch wieder 0,7 Prozent im Plus. Der Leerverkäufer wirft der RBI darin Fehlverhalten ihrer russischen Tochterbank im Zusammenhang mit westlichen Sanktionen vor. Grizzly Research ist ein auf Leerverkäufe spezialisiertes US-Unternehmen, das von fallenden Kursen profitiert und in der Vergangenheit bereits mit kritischen Berichten für Aufsehen gesorgt hat.
Die RBI hatte die Vorwürfe bereits am Donnerstagabend entschieden [USN:L8N4591PR TEXT:"zurückgewiesen"] und prüft ebenfalls juristische Schritte. Der Bericht enthalte sachliche Fehler, erklärte die Bank. So würden Unternehmen als Kunden genannt, die niemals Kunden der RBI gewesen seien. Analysten der Erste Group bezeichneten die Zurückweisung als "stark und entschieden", sie erwarten eine weitere Erholung der Aktie.
Die RBI ist die größte westliche Bank, die auch nach dem russischen Angriff auf die Ukraine noch in Russland tätig ist. Sie steht seit langem unter dem Druck von Regulierern, sich aus dem Land zurückzuziehen, und war deshalb auch bereits im Fokus der US-Sanktionsbehörde OFAC.

items.body:
A Ethiopian Airlines adiou sua decisão sobre um pedido de 25 aeronaves para voos regionais, afirmou nesta sexta-feira o presidente-executivo Mesfin Tasew Bekele, depois que o executivo havia declarado, em junho, que a decisão seria tomada até setembro.

items.title: Iraq lifts restrictions on civilian use of western airspace
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Iraq said on Friday it had returned restricted airspace in the western part of the country to civilian authorities, ending limits that had been in place for military operations since 2016, the transport ministry said in a statement.
items.body:
Iraq said on Friday it had returned restricted airspace in the western part of the country to civilian authorities, ending limits that had been in place for military operations since 2016, the transport ministry said in a statement.
The ministry said all previously reserved zones stretching across western Iraq from north to south had been handed over to the authority responsible for airports and air navigation for use by civil aviation.
The move is expected to give Iraqi aviation authorities more room to redesign flight routes, ease restrictions on aircraft movement and improve the efficiency of airspace use.
The restricted areas had been designated for military operations against Islamic State group in 2016 and 2017, when large parts of Iraq's western desert were used as bases for those operations.
"It has been officially confirmed by the airspace management team at the air operations center that the military air zones listed in the Iraqi aeronautical guide are no longer being used for military operations," Ehab Saad Karim, director of the General Company for Airports and Air Navigation Management, told a press conference.
Karim said the decision followed years of technical and institutional work aimed at improving the efficiency and flow of air traffic.
Reopening the routes would boost revenue, improve the flow of civilian air traffic and support the national economy, he added.
Transport Ministry spokesperson Hussein Ahmed told Reuters that the technical and regulatory steps would be completed by October 1.
The ministry said the lifting of restrictions linked to military zones was part of withdrawal procedures, as Iraq and the United States implement arrangements for the departure of remaining troops from the US-led international coalition.

items.title: OMS alerta para crescente déficit na força de trabalho em saúde à medida que profissionais e pacientes envelhecem
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Organização Mundial da Saúde alertou nesta sexta-feira para uma escassez de profissionais da área médica em todo o mundo na década de 2030, já que um quarto dos médicos deve se aposentar na próxima década.
items.body:
A Organização Mundial da Saúde alertou nesta sexta-feira para uma escassez de profissionais da área médica em todo o mundo na década de 2030, já que um quarto dos médicos deve se aposentar na próxima década.
“Em muitos países, tanto a população quanto os profissionais de saúde estão envelhecendo ao mesmo tempo. Isso pode agravar a escassez global prevista de 11,1 milhões de profissionais de saúde até 2030”, afirmou a OMS em comunicado que acompanha um importante relatório sobre tendências da força de trabalho, baseado em dados de mais de 100 países.
Até 2030, estima-se que 67 países não terão pessoal suficiente para manter os padrões de tratamento médico de que desfrutam atualmente, afirmou o relatório.
Para manter a atual proporção de profissionais de saúde em relação à população, são necessários mais 832 mil profissionais de saúde, o que poderia aumentar a dependência de profissionais de saúde estrangeiros nos países mais pobres, segundo o relatório, com potencial impacto nos padrões de atendimento médico nessas regiões.
Os países de renda mais alta, incluindo muitos na Europa, devem ser os mais afetados, uma vez que possuem uma proporção maior de profissionais de saúde mais idosos, de acordo com o relatório. Nesses países, um em cada três médicos se aposentará nos próximos dez anos, afirma o relatório.

items.title: Bericht: Mercedes-Management fordert Einführung von 38-Stunden-Woche
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: In den Verhandlungen über die Arbeitszeit bei Mercedes-Benz fordert das Management einem Bericht zufolge eine Arbeitszeiterhöhung um drei Stunden pro Woche. Der Arbeitnehmerseite sei ein Vorschlag für eine 38-Stunden-Woche unterbreitet worden, berichtete das "Handelsblatt" am Freitag unter Berufung auf Insider. Diskutiert werde, ob diese längere Arbeitszeit dauerhaft oder befristet gelten solle.
items.body:
In den Verhandlungen über die Arbeitszeit bei Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) fordert das Management einem Bericht zufolge eine Arbeitszeiterhöhung um drei Stunden pro Woche. Der Arbeitnehmerseite sei ein Vorschlag für eine 38-Stunden-Woche unterbreitet worden, berichtete das "Handelsblatt" am Freitag unter Berufung auf Insider. Diskutiert werde, ob diese längere Arbeitszeit dauerhaft oder befristet gelten solle.
Ein Mercedes-Sprecher teilte dazu mit, die strukturellen Kosten in Deutschland - inklusive der Arbeitskosten - seien im internationalen Vergleich nicht wettbewerbsfähig. Das Unternehmen verhandle mit den Arbeitnehmern darüber, wie gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen gefunden werden könnten, die die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit stärkten, Investitionen weiterhin rechtfertigten und die starken Wurzeln von Mercedes-Benz in Deutschland langfristig sicherten. Dazu gehöre unter anderem auch eine Erhöhung der Arbeitszeit ohne Lohnausgleich. "Aus Sicht des Unternehmens ist dies der direkteste und fairste Weg, Arbeitskosten schnell zu senken."
Die IG Metall lehnt die Abkehr von der 35-Stunden-Woche strikt ab. Vor der anstehenden Tarifrunde für die Metall- und Elektroindustrie sagte IG-Metall-Chefin Christiane Benner, sollten solche Forderungen von den regionalen Arbeitgeberverbänden erhoben werden, wolle die Gewerkschaft diese entschieden zurückweisen.

items.title: How the EU's age-verification app for children would work
items.author: Leo Marchandon
items.creator: Leo Marchandon
items.summary: The European Commission proposed on Thursday banning children under 13 from social media, with parent-supervised accounts until 15.
items.body:
The European Commission proposed on Thursday [USN:L8N4590IF TEXT:"banning"] children under 13 from social media, with parent-supervised accounts until 15.
Enforcement would rely on a tool Brussels built itself: a free, open-source age verification app that tells a platform whether a user meets an age threshold without revealing their identity.
Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said Brussels "looked at Australia," which banned social media for under-16s last year, when drafting the proposal.
If passed, the proposed Kids Act would create the world's largest social media access restriction, covering 450 million people across 27 countries.
WHAT IS THE APP? A smartphone app developed by the European Commission, presented in April 2026. It is being rolled out through member states, with seven pilot countries: Cyprus, Denmark, [USN:L6N4500G4 TEXT:"France"], [USN:L1N40R096 TEXT:"Greece"], Ireland, Italy and Spain. The Commission expects EU-wide availability by the end of 2026.
It will also be used to prove users are over 18 when accessing adult sites, a restriction already implemented under the Digital Services Act.
Under the proposed Kids Act, non-compliance with minors' rules would fall under DSA enforcement, where penalties can reach up to 6% of global turnover.
The Commission writes the code and standards; the system itself is decentralised. Member states run it through issuers they designate, and the proofs live on the user's phone. There is no central EU database of ages or of who verified whom.
HOW DOES IT WORK? A user proves their age once to a nationally designated issuer — a body vetted by the member state, which can be a digital ID provider, a bank or a post office. At a restricted site, the app certifies that the user is above the required age threshold. The platform receives only a yes-or-no response.
Issuance and verification are handled by separate entities. The proof provider is not told which service the proof was used for. Each proof works only once, preventing cross-service tracking. No identity documents or biometric data are retained. The code is open-source, allowing independent scrutiny.
The significance of the EU approach is that it provides a common age-verification mechanism rather than leaving individual platforms to develop and enforce their own systems.
"Online platforms can easily rely on our age verification app. So there are no more excuses," von der Leyen said.
HOW DOES IT DIFFER FROM AUSTRALIA? Australia legislated a minimum age of 16 but prescribed no method and built no state infrastructure. Everything was left to the platforms themselves, using commercial vendors.
A shadow trial reported by Reuters found platforms requested age proof on none of 50 test accounts declaring an age of 16. Canberra has since doubled maximum fines and threatened court action.
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT? The proposal must be approved by EU member states and the European Parliament before becoming law.
Greece, which is legislating an under-15 ban, said it expects "clear convergence" with its own approach and aims for its law to take effect early next year.
Spain's under-16 ban awaits a parliamentary vote. Digital Transformation Minister Oscar Lopez says age systems must "strike a balance with the right to privacy". Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said the message to the "techno-oligarchs" is that "childhood is protected by our democracies".
In France, however, the Constitutional Council last month blocked a national under-15 ban, deeming it an unconstitutional and disproportionate infringement on freedom of expression. The ruling illustrates that the legal framework remains contested and that national courts will help shape the environment in which the EU regulation is implemented.

It will also be used to prove users are over 18 when accessing adult sites, a restriction already implemented under the Digital Services Act. 
Under the proposed Kids Act, non-compliance with minors' rules would fall under DSA enforcement, where penalties can reach up to 6 per cent of global turnover.
The Commission writes the code and standards; the system itself is decentralised. Member states run it through issuers they designate, and the proofs live on the user's phone. There is no central EU database of ages or of who verified whom.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
A user proves their age once to a nationally designated issuer — a body vetted by the member state, which can be a digital ID provider, a bank or a post office. At a restricted site, the app certifies that the user is above the required age threshold. The platform receives only a yes-or-no response.
Issuance and verification are handled by separate entities. The proof provider is not told which service the proof was used for. Each proof works only once, preventing cross-service tracking. No identity documents or biometric data are retained. The code is open-source, allowing independent scrutiny.
The significance of the EU approach is that it provides a common age-verification mechanism rather than leaving individual platforms to develop and enforce their own systems.
"Online platforms can easily rely on our age verification app. So there are no more excuses," von der Leyen said.
HOW DOES IT DIFFER FROM AUSTRALIA?
Australia legislated a minimum age of 16 but prescribed no method and built no state infrastructure. Everything was left to the platforms themselves, using commercial vendors.
A shadow trial reported by Reuters found platforms requested age proof on none of 50 test accounts declaring an age of 16. Canberra has since doubled maximum fines and threatened court action.
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT?
The proposal must be approved by EU member states and the European Parliament before becoming law.
Greece, which is legislating an under-15 ban, said it expects "clear convergence" with its own approach and aims for its law to take effect early next year.
Spain's under-16 ban awaits a parliamentary vote. Digital Transformation Minister Oscar Lopez says age systems must "strike a balance with the right to privacy". Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez said the message to the "techno-oligarchs" is that "childhood is protected by our democracies".
In France, however, the Constitutional Council last month blocked a national under-15 ban, deeming it an unconstitutional and disproportionate infringement on freedom of expression. The ruling illustrates that the legal framework remains contested and that national courts will help shape the environment in which the EU regulation is implemented.

items.title: South Sudanese migrant jailed in UK for piloting record Channel boat crossing
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A South Sudanese man was jailed for two years and three months in an English court on Friday after he admitted piloting a small boat across the Channel from France, which carried a then-record 165 people.
items.body:
A South Sudanese man was jailed for two years and three months in an English court on Friday after he admitted piloting a small boat across the Channel from France, which carried a then-record 165 people.
Chan Mathok Atak, 19, previously pleaded guilty to endangering another during a July crossing to Britain in an inflatable dinghy.
The record for most migrants travelling to Britain across the Channel by small boat was broken again last month, when 230 people made the journey.
Atak's sentencing comes as the numbers of those arriving in Britain across the Channel have fallen, but the crossings remain a prominent political issue which successive British governments have struggled to tackle.
Earlier this month, hundreds of black-clad [USN:L8N44Z0BU TEXT:"protesters gathered"] twice in two days on Britain's south coast, blocking streets in response to arrivals of small boats, which a government minister described as "thuggish".
[USN:L6N44W0QT TEXT:"Right-wing opposition parties"] and anti-migration activists have called for more action, but [USN:L8N44W0HQ TEXT:"greater cooperation"] with French authorities and even [USN:L1N3Z10LK TEXT:"repeated deaths"] have not deterred many people from seeking to make the perilous journey.
OVERCROWDED DINGHY CARRIED 165 PEOPLE Atak was sentenced to 27 months in prison at Canterbury Crown Court. Prosecutor James Harrison said Atak piloted the dinghy for at least 90 minutes while it carried 164 other people, including 31 children aged 14 to 17.
He said there was no navigational or first aid equipment on the boat, which had only one of its two engines working and was slowly deflating and taking on sea water before it was intercepted by Britain's Border Force.
Atak's lawyer Audrey Cherryl Mogan said Atak was a young asylum seeker from South Sudan who did not have anything to do with the number of people or the conditions on board.
Judge Sarah Counsell accepted there was no evidence Atak organised the journey, but said that "those who chose to steer such vessels assume responsibility for the safety of those on board".
"This undermines public confidence in the immigration system and places considerable strain on already stretched public resources," she added.
The National Crime Agency's senior investigating officer John Turner said in a statement: "Chan Atak was unimaginably reckless and his actions could have easily resulted in many deaths had this boat not been intercepted."

items.body:
Las exportaciones de soja de Brasil en 2026 alcanzarían un total de 115 millones de toneladas métricas, informó el viernes la asociación de procesadores Abiove, que ha rebajado su previsión en 400.000 toneladas después de que China —el mayor importador mundial— intensificó sus compras de soja estadounidense.
Esta medida supone el primer recorte de Abiove en sus estimaciones mensuales desde, al menos, marzo.
Aun así, se sigue estimando que las exportaciones de soja de Brasil en 2026 aumentarán un 6,3% con respecto al año anterior.
Brasil, el mayor productor y exportador mundial de soja, recolectó una cosecha récord de más de 180 millones de toneladas en el primer semestre del año.

items.title: Phillies set to use bullpen game vs. struggling Mets
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies are making adjustments to cover the loss of All-Star left-hander Jesus Luzardo, who was placed on the 15-day injured list this week due to left shoulder inflammation.
items.body:
The Philadelphia Phillies are making adjustments to cover the loss of All-Star left-hander Jesus Luzardo, who was placed on the 15-day injured list this week due to left shoulder inflammation.
The Phillies will opt for a bullpen game when they continue a four-game series against the host New York Mets on Friday night.
The plan likely will feature new addition Jose Urquidy (2-2, 5.28 ERA) working several innings. The 31-year-old right-hander was claimed off waivers on Thursday, two days after being designated for assignment by the Chicago White Sox.
Urquidy last pitched on Sept. 8, when he threw 65 pitches over four innings in a no-decision against the Pittsburgh Pirates. He gave up two runs and five hits in Chicago's 9-3 loss.
"I think missing (Luzardo's) start puts you in a bullpen game in some fashion, and a bullpen game one inning at a time is a little different than having a bulk guy in there who can throw 70 to 75 pitches," Phillies interim manager Don Mattingly said. "So we're in a little better shape now."
Urquidy is 1-0 with a 1.29 ERA in two career games (one start) vs. New York. He allowed one unearned run over one inning and earned the save against the Mets as a member of the Pirates on March 29.
Philadelphia (85-68) is tied with the Chicago Cubs (85-68) for the top wild-card spot in the National League after winning the series opener against the Mets 3-0 on Thursday.
The Phillies on Friday could be without right-handed reliever Jonathan Bowlan, who exited Thursday's game in the eighth inning with right groin tightness.
New York (69-84) has lost five straight games and will start left-hander Zac Thornton (4-5, 3.44) on Friday. He bounced back after giving up four home runs in a loss to the San Francisco Giants with a solid outing against the New York Yankees last Saturday.
Thornton, 24, yielded two runs on five hits over seven innings in a 12-2 road win over the Yankees.
"It was great, fun to watch, especially after the last outing," Mets interim manager Andy Green said. "Seeing somebody bounce back like that -- I think we value resilience at an incredibly high level, and to see it show up in a stadium like this, in a game like that, it's fun. He was on attack from the get-go and had some of the best velocity we've seen from him."
Thornton will start vs. the Phillies for the second time in his career. He tossed six innings of one-run ball in a no-decision against them on June 26.
The Mets are monitoring the status of first baseman Jared Young, who was taken off the field on a stretcher after being kneed in the head by teammate Nolan McLean on a play at first base on Thursday.
The play occurred with two outs in the sixth inning when McLean, the Mets' starting pitcher, moved toward first to cover the bag on a dribbler hit by the Phillies' Justin Crawford. McLean was attempting to leap over Young when the collision occurred.
Young was down on the field for several minutes before being put on a stretcher. He gave a thumbs-up to the crowd as he was carted off the field.
The team soon posted on social media, "Jared Young is being taken to hospital for further examination. He has feeling in his extremities. Additional updates will be provided when possible."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo es convocado por DT Jorge Jesús para su primera selección de Portugal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo ha sido incluido en la primera convocatoria de 25 jugadores del nuevo seleccionador de Portugal, Jorge Jesús, para los próximos cuatro partidos de la Liga de Naciones que disputará la actual campeona.
items.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo ha sido incluido en la primera convocatoria de 25 jugadores del nuevo seleccionador de Portugal, Jorge Jesús, para los próximos cuatro partidos de la Liga de Naciones que disputará la actual campeona.
En agosto, Ronaldo avivó los rumores sobre sus planes de retiro tras afirmar que el año que viene sería probablemente el último de su carrera como jugador.
El capitán de Portugal, de 41 años, es uno de los futbolistas más laureados de la historia del fútbol, ya que ha ganado importantes trofeos con el Manchester United, el Real Madrid, la Juventus y su actual club, el Al-Nassr, desde que debutó con el primer equipo del Sporting en 2002.
Ronaldo, cinco veces ganador del Balón de Oro, no pudo añadir un título mundial a su palmarés después de que Portugal quedara eliminado en octavos de final ante la selección que terminaría siendo campeona, España, lo que dejó el mayor premio de este deporte ausente de su vitrina de trofeos.
Ronaldo confirmó en julio que el Mundial de 2026 sería el último para él, pero no quiso tomar una decisión precipitada sobre su futuro en la selección.
"Lo que importa es su rendimiento. El pasado no cuenta", dijo Jorge Jesús en una rueda de prensa el viernes. "En esta plantilla hay 13 jugadores que han trabajado conmigo. No tengo un núcleo fijo, así que, dentro de este grupo, había varios jugadores que eran importantes para el equipo".
"Cris es un jugador como cualquier otro. Si rinde, juega; si no, no. Tiene un estatus diferente -cuenta con cinco Balones de Oro-, pero ¿influye eso en mis decisiones? No. Sin embargo, el hecho de que sea diferente sí que influye".
Jesús debutará como seleccionador de Portugal frente a Gales de local el 24 de septiembre. A continuación, Portugal viajará para enfrentarse a Noruega y Dinamarca el 27 de septiembre y el 1 de octubre, respectivamente, antes de recibir a Noruega el 4 de octubre.
Portugal nombró en julio al exentrenador del Al-Nassr, de 72 años, pocos días después de que el español Roberto Martínez dimitiera tras la eliminación del país en el Mundial.

items.title: EU waste proposal would ban India from importing bloc's metal scrap
items.author: Julia Payne
items.creator: Julia Payne
items.summary: India will be among the countries barred from importing EU metal waste, including aluminium scrap, under a new law due to take effect in May 2027, according to a European Commission proposal setting out exemptions for non-OECD countries.
items.body:
India will be among the countries barred from importing EU metal waste, including aluminium scrap, under a new law due to take effect in May 2027, according to a European Commission proposal setting out exemptions for non-OECD countries.
The Commission published the proposal on Friday, confirming an earlier Reuters [USN:L8N4530IZ TEXT:"report"], and opened a public consultation on the exemptions list until October 16.
The move comes after the Commission earlier this month [USN:L1N44W0MS TEXT:"ditched"] a plan to impose a 15% export duty on aluminium scrap following pressure from the biggest buyer — India. Disagreements among EU officials diluted the trade proposal by exempting India, significantly reducing its impact.
The Commission has argued that the same objective can be achieved through the bloc's waste shipment rules rather than trade measures.
Industry group European Aluminium remains unconvinced, however, having viewed the proposed export duty as crucial to keeping more of the low-cost raw material within Europe for struggling smelters.
The Waste Shipment Regulation will take effect in May 2027. The Commission said 32 non-OECD countries applied for exemptions covering non-hazardous waste categories including paper, plastics, rubber, metal and glass. Exemptions are granted only if applicants can demonstrate the waste will be treated in an "environmentally sound manner".
Metal waste faces stricter scrutiny because it presents a "higher hazard profile ... due to the potential presence of persistent and toxic heavy metals," the Commission said.
The EU executive added that the exemptions list, known as a delegated act, will be updated regularly, at least every two years, and countries will be able to reapply.

items.title: BEE4 lista Grupo Vellore e chega a cinco companhias emissoras sob regime Fácil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A BEE4, infraestrutura de mercado de capitais dedicada exclusivamente às pequenas e médias empresas, anunciou nesta sexta-feira a listagem do Grupo Vellore, ampliando para cinco o número de companhias emissoras enquadradas no regime Fácil em sua plataforma.
items.body:
A BEE4, infraestrutura de mercado de capitais dedicada exclusivamente às pequenas e médias empresas, anunciou nesta sexta-feira a listagem do Grupo Vellore, ampliando para cinco o número de companhias emissoras enquadradas no regime Fácil em sua plataforma.
Com sede em Pinhais, na região metropolitana de Curitiba, o Grupo Vellore teve faturamento de R$327 milhões no ano passado, crescimento de 80% em relação a 2024, e seu plano estratégico inclui alcançar uma receita anual de R$1 bilhão em 2030. A companhia possui cerca de sete mil pontos de venda no Brasil e exporta para sete países. A empresa é dona das marcas Foxlux, que comercializa materiais elétricos e de iluminação, e Famastil, de ferramentas para construção civil e jardinagem.
A operação aconteceu no momento em que o regime Fácil, criado pela Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM) para facilitar o acesso de pequenas e médias empresas ao mercado de capitais, completa seis meses de vigência.
A listagem, registrada na noite de quinta-feira, ocorreu após a empresa vencer a primeira edição do reality show Rota Fácil, [USN:L1N3UJ02E TEXT:"lançado"] no ano passado pela BEE4 para estimular a entrada de PMEs no mercado de capitais. Ela optou pela categoria A do Regime Fácil, que permite captações tanto via ações quanto por instrumentos de renda fixa.
De acordo com a BEE4, a Vellore recebeu um pacote de subsídios para ser listada, que incluiu auditoria contábil independente, assessoria jurídica, dois anos de isenção na escrituração da primeira operação e subsídio de custos relacionados às taxas de listagem na CVM e no mercado BEE4.
Ao todo, foram realizadas quatro emissões de renda fixa e duas de ações na BEE4 sob o regime Fácil, sendo que um mesmo emissor acessou o mercado nas duas modalidades.

items.title: Caviar and champagne: Air France's luxury shift helps ride out Iran war impact
items.author: Joanna Plucinska
items.creator: Joanna Plucinska
items.summary: With generous helpings of caviar and champagne, Air France's costly bet on luxury appears to be paying off, helping the Paris-based carrier weather the fallout from the Iran war, Chief Executive Ben Smith told Reuters on Friday.
items.body:
With generous helpings of caviar and champagne, Air France's costly bet on luxury appears to be paying off, helping the Paris-based carrier weather the fallout from the Iran war, Chief Executive Ben Smith told Reuters on Friday.
Airlines worldwide, including parent Air France-KLM (AIRF.PA) , are grappling with soaring jet fuel bills and disrupted travel patterns caused by the nearly seven-month-old Iran war , which has forced some to cut capacity and rein in spending.
Air France, meanwhile, is riding things out. The airline has tapped into the buzz created by the "Emily in Paris" TV show and tourists' enduring fascination with the French capital's fashion, food and hotel scene. It has doubled down on premium offerings, upgrading onboard menus with luxury-branded products and investing heavily in its most lucrative cabins.
"All the luxury brands are based in Paris. We have more Michelin-starred restaurants than anywhere in the world in Paris," Smith said on the sidelines of a London awards show where Air France won best first-class cabin.
"So it is a very specific city. Not only is it gorgeous as a cultural location, but as a luxury city."
Europe's three largest airline groups, including British Airways owner IAG (ICAG.L) and Lufthansa (LHAG.DE) , have all unveiled redesigned first-class cabins in recent years as they chase growing demand for premium travel, particularly from affluent US passengers.
Smith said Air France's wealthiest customers have not been put off by higher prices. Some former private jet users are even switching to first class, he said, seeking to avoid the scrutiny attached to the higher emissions associated with private flights.
Premium, business and first-class cabins have all delivered growth in bookings and revenue this year, despite Air France [USN:L1N43W07M TEXT:"raising fares"] to offset surging fuel costs, Smith said.
Revenue from first-class and premium travel has risen 11%, according to company data. Smith also played down concerns that rising inflation in the US could hit premium spending.
"We've raised ticket prices significantly, but no, it's quite solid. It's better than I would have expected," he said.
items.raw_description: With generous helpings of caviar and champagne, Air France's costly bet on luxury appears to be paying off, helping the Paris-based carrier weather the fallout from the Iran war, Chief Executive Ben Smith told Reuters on Friday.

items.title: Private jet boom raises climate concerns
items.author: Sharon Kimathi
items.creator: Sharon Kimathi
items.summary: Today’s newsletter tackles a topic that’s been on my radar – private jets.
items.body:
Today’s newsletter tackles a topic that’s been on my radar – private jets.
A recent report by US think-tank the Institute for Policy Studies examines the environmental impact of private aviation, arguing that growth in private jet ownership is widening the gap between luxury consumption and climate goals.
The study estimates there are now 3,428 billionaires worldwide and says [USN:L6N42Y016 TEXT:"private jet ownership and use"] have expanded alongside growing wealth.
The US is driving much of that growth, accounting for nearly 69% of the world’s registered jets, according to the report.
The report notes that private jet operations and greenhouse gas emissions in two US states alone, Florida and Texas, are greater than the 27 member countries of the European Union combined, making it one of the most polluting forms of transport and representing the fastest growing segment of aviation emissions.
“Most people wish they could fly private, especially with how degrading the experience of commercial travel is,” said Chuck Collins, a co-author of the study.
“But people don’t know that we subsidize commercial and private jet consumption here in the US and it’s the most polluting form of transportation which is harming us,” he added.
Commercial airline passengers pay several taxes and carrier-imposed fees whenever they purchase an airplane ticket, whereas private jets users, by comparison, only pay a federal excise tax on jet fuel of 21.9 cents per gallon.
Additionally, there are currently eight US states that have full or near-total sales tax exemptions on the purchase of a private jet.
As for pollution, private jets typically travel at higher altitudes than standard commercial airliners which can have a bigger impact on the climate because their emissions create warming effects beyond the CO2 emissions they release.
Collins and his co-authors also claim that private jets are used mainly for recreational purposes, [USN:L6N42B0ON TEXT:"creating “carbon bombs” "]for global gatherings such as [USN:L8N33W4B5 TEXT:"Davos"], the Cannes Film Festival, the US Masters Golf Tournament or the Monaco Grand Prix.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup saw more than 92,000 private jet flights, emitting 150 kilotons of excess emissions – the equivalent of 34,000 gas-guzzling cars driving for a year, according to the report.
So, what’s the solution? Collins proposes that commercial airlines must advocate for private jets to pay their fair share of taxes, upgrade the commercial travel customer experience in addition to a wider cultural and behavioural shift.
“There are things institutions can do to discourage private jets and invest in high-speed rail, stop short haul flights and find real alternatives. There also needs to be a culture shift backed with government action to move us away from private jet use which should be seen as embarrassing,” he added.
“There are artists and performers who refuse to fly private and it’s time to say, ‘shame on people flying private’. You don’t see people showing up with mink coats anywhere anymore as the wealthy are embarrassed to wear them and there should be the same stigma for flying on a private jet.”

Click here to find out the 15 finalists of the coveted Earthshot Prize, an environmental award founded by Britain’s Prince William in 2020 which recognizes solutions from around the world that are dedicated to solving the planet’s greatest environmental challenges. The 15 finalists are in the running to be awarded £1 million each across five categories addressing oceans, climate change, waste, conservation and air quality.
Indonesia's choking wildfire haze
Indonesia’s province of West Kalimantan on Borneo is [USN:L6N4560JQ TEXT:"one of the areas worst hit"] by the country’s most [USN:L6N4580FI TEXT:"intense wildfires in 11 years"] as "super-El Niño" weather conditions drive up temperatures and cause punishing droughts. The air has also turned unhealthy in neighbouring Singapore and[USN:L6N44Z05J TEXT:" Malaysia"] because of the transboundary smog, often called haze in Southeast Asia's humid weather.
Nagoya faces possible typhoon threat early in Asian Games
Asian Games organizers are bracing for [USN:L4N4590DD TEXT:"possible weather disruption"] in the opening few days of the multi-sports gathering, with the possibility of a typhoon hitting the Aichi-Nagoya coast on September 21. Tropical storm Dujuan was located off Japan's Pacific coast on Thursday and heading northwest towards central Japan, where Nagoya is located.

items.title: Barcelona's Lamine says he has experienced racism 'a thousand times'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Barcelona forward Lamine Yamal said he has experienced racism "a thousand times", with many people unaware that their comments or behaviour are racist.
items.body:
Barcelona forward Lamine Yamal said he has experienced racism "a thousand times", with many people unaware that their comments or behaviour are racist.
The 19-year-old has been the target of racial abuse during his rapid rise to prominence.
In October 2024, footage appeared to show Lamine, Raphinha and Ansu Fati being racially abused during Barcelona's match against Real Madrid at the Santiago Bernabeu.
The Spanish Observatory on Racism and Xenophobia said in a bulletin published in March that Lamine and Vinicius Jr were the most frequent targets of online racist abuse in Spain in the final quarter of 2025.
Asked by former Argentina international Jorge Valdano in an interview with Spanish broadcaster Movistar whether he had directly experienced racism, Lamine said: "A thousand times.
"People are indirectly racist toward you, but maybe don't realise it. There are a lot of comments or looks that are racist and they don't even notice.
"If someone calls me Black, it’s not going to bother me at all, ultimately I'm Black, I'm not any other colour. Another thing is whether it's good or bad, whether they're saying it to offend me.
"But if I’m playing a match and they paid for a ticket to see me, I’m not going to get angry just because they disrespected me."
LaLiga has stepped up efforts to combat racist abuse in stadiums following a number of high-profile incidents in Spanish football in recent years.

items.title: タイ格付け見通しを「安定的」に引き上げ、フィッチ　債務安定見通し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１８日 ロイター] - フィッチ・レーティングスは１８日、タイの格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」から「安定的」に引き上げた。政府債務が中期的におおむね安定するとの確信が強まったことや、２０２６年初めの総選挙を経て政治状況が改善するとの見方を理由に挙げた。

・今回の見通し引き上げは、債務増加と成長鈍化への懸念から格下げの可能性を指摘した２５年の状況からの反転となる。

・タイ経済は、中東情勢の緊張を受けたエネルギーコストの上昇と観光需要の軟化にもかかわらず底堅さを維持しており、テクノロジー分野やデータセンター投資が成長を下支えしている。

２月の選挙ではアヌティン・チャンウィーラクン首相率いる連立政権が過半数を確保して政策の不透明感が和らぎ、政治的な移行が円滑に進んだ。

・債務水準が高く長期的な成長見通しは緩やかだが、タイの強固な対外収支と、政府債務の大半を国内で調達できる能力が、投資適格級を引き続き支えていると指摘。

・ムーディーズは４月、米関税による下振れリスクの低下を理由にタイの見通しを「安定的」に引き上げた。

・フィッチはタイのソブリン格付け「ＢＢＢ＋」を確認した。

COPENHAGEN, Sept 18 (Reuters) – Denmark is speeding up a donation to Ukraine in response to a recent incident in which a Russian warship fired flares towards a Danish military helicopter, narrowly missing the aircraft, the Nordic country’s government said on Friday.

Denmark on Monday said a Russian frigate fired flares without warning at the helicopter as it sought to photograph the ship in international waters, while Moscow in response accused Denmark of carrying out dangerous manoeuvres near its vessel.

The new support package for Ukraine was worth an estimated 1.8 billion Danish crowns ($276 million) and will be used for air defences, the government said.

Show Full Article

“If the Russians think they can rattle us… then our response is to ramp up our support for Ukraine faster than we had intended,” Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus told reporters after a meeting with parliamentarians.

Denmark has been among Ukraine’s most vocal supporters since Russia’s full-scale invasion in 2022 and is a leading provider of financial aid on a per-capita basis.

“If anyone thinks they can pressure us to hold back on our support for Ukraine, they are mistaken,” Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen said.

($1 = 6.5228 Danish crowns)

items.title: Nestlé examine ses options après la décision du Kremlin de saisir ses activités en Russie
items.author: John Revill
items.creator: John Revill
items.summary: Nestlé a déclaré vendredi examiner toutes les options possibles pour protéger ses intérêts en Russie à la suite de la décision du Kremlin de transférer les actifs du groupe agroalimentaire suisse dans le pays, ainsi que ceux du distributeur français Auchan, à des sociétés russes.
items.body:
Nestlé (NESN.S) a déclaré vendredi examiner toutes les options possibles pour protéger ses intérêts en Russie à la suite de la décision du Kremlin de [USN:L8N459268 TEXT:"transférer"] les actifs du groupe agroalimentaire suisse dans le pays, ainsi que ceux du distributeur français Auchan, à des sociétés russes.
Le fabricant du café Nescafé et des barres chocolatées KitKat a précisé avoir pris acte de cette décision, annoncée jeudi par décret présidentiel, ajoutant qu'il évaluait la situation.
"Nestlé s'engage à prendre toutes les mesures nécessaires pour protéger ses droits et assurer la continuité de ses activités dans l'intérêt de toutes les parties prenantes, en particulier de ses employés", dit la société suisse dans un communiqué.
Vers 10h40 GMT, l'action Nestlé reculait de 2,26%, accusant l'une des plus fortes baisses de la Bourse de Zurich.
Le titre pâtit également de l'annonce faite dans la matinée par l'autorité indienne de la régulation alimentaire qu'elle avait constaté qu'un échantillon d'aliments pour bébés de Nestlé ne répondait pas aux normes, ajoutant avoir engagé une procédure judiciaire à l'encontre de l'entreprise.
Auchan, qui emploie environ 30.000 personnes en Russie dans 230 magasins et une activité de commerce en ligne, s'est refusé à tout commentaire.
Moscou a renforcé son contrôle sur les avoirs détenus par des étrangers en Russie depuis le début de son invasion à grande échelle de l'Ukraine en février 2022.
En vertu d'un décret signé par Vladimir Poutine en 2023, le pays peut placer sous administration temporaire les avoirs de pays qu'elle juge "hostiles".
Le porte-parole du Kremlin, Dmitri Peskov, a d'ailleurs dit aux journalistes que la politique avait joué un rôle dans ces décisions.
Sans les citer nommément, il a affirmé que la Suisse et la France étaient "activement impliqués dans des actions militaires" contre la Russie, notamment "les frappes menées par le régime de Kyiv contre des infrastructures économiques pacifiques".
La Suisse, vivement critiquée par le Kremlin pour avoir emboîté le pas à l'Union européenne dans l'imposition les sanctions contre de la Russie en raison de la guerre en Ukraine, n'a fait aucun commentaire dans l'immédiat à ce sujet.
ADMINISTRATION PROVISOIRE Nestlé possède six usines en Russie qui produisent du café, des aliments pour animaux de compagnie et des préparations pour nourrissons.
L'entreprise a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires d'environ deux milliards de francs suisses (2,11 milliards d'euros) en Russie en 2021, dernière année pour laquelle elle a publié des données financières, et y emploie environ 7.000 personnes.
Ce chiffre d'affaires représente environ 2% des ventes totales de Nestlé, mais les analystes financiers pensent que cette part a diminué du fait de la réduction des activités du groupe en Russie depuis la guerre.
D'autres entreprises occidentales ont vendu leurs actifs russes ou les ont confiés à des dirigeants locaux afin de se conformer aux sanctions ou en réponse aux menaces de Moscou de saisir les actifs détenus par des étrangers.
Nestlé a justifié la poursuite de ses activités en Russie en faisant valoir qu'en tant que producteur alimentaire, elle fournit des biens de première nécessité.
En 2023, Moscou a pris le contrôle des activités russes du groupe agroalimentaire français Danone (DANO.PA) et de la participation du brasseur danois Carlsberg (CARLb.CO) dans une brasserie locale.
Au sujet des actifs de Nestlé et d'Auchan qui viennent d'être saisis, Dmitri Peskov, a précisé que, à ce stade, seule une mise sous administration provisoire était à l'ordre du jour.

items.title: Memphis Depay fica de fora da primeira convocação de Xavi na seleção da Holanda
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O artilheiro histórico da Holanda, Memphis Depay, ficou de fora, mas o capitão Virgil van Dijk permanece na seleção após primeira convocação do novo técnico, Xavi Hernández, nesta sexta-feira, para jogos da Liga das Nações.
items.body:
O artilheiro histórico da Holanda, Memphis Depay, ficou de fora, mas o capitão Virgil van Dijk permanece na seleção após primeira convocação do novo técnico, Xavi Hernández, nesta sexta-feira, para jogos da Liga das Nações.
Depay atuou apenas saindo do banco de reservas na Copa do Mundo e segue com o recorde nacional de 55 gols. Sua ausência era amplamente esperada e pode sinalizar o fim da carreira internacional do atacante de 32 anos, após 112 partidas.
O jogador desperdiçou pênalti decisivo pelo Corinthians nesta semana pela Copa Libertadores.
Van Dijk disse no mês passado que avaliaria seu futuro na seleção após conversar com o novo técnico, mas decidiu continuar. A Holanda enfrenta Alemanha, Grécia e Sérvia duas vezes em quatro partidas da Liga das Nações durante a janela internacional prolongada de três semanas.
Xavi convocou pela primeira vez Ruben van Bommel e Gjivai Zechiel e trouxe de volta o meio-campista Joey Veerman, mas estará sem Frenkie de Jong, que ainda se recupera de uma lesão no joelho sofrida na Copa do Mundo.
Marten de Roon e Wout Weghorst também não foram incluídos na convocação de 26 jogadores, assim como Guus Til e o meio-campista lesionado do Brighton & Hove Albion, Mats Wieffer.
Jeremie Frimpong, Kenneth Taylor e Jurrien Timber, que não participaram da Copa do Mundo, retornam ao elenco.
Veja os convocados:
Goleiros: Mark Flekken (Bayer Leverkusen), Robin Roefs (Sunderland), Bart Verbruggen (Brighton & Hove Albion)
Defensores: Nathan Ake (Fenerbahçe), Denzel Dumfries (Real Madrid), Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool), Lutsharel Geertruida (PSV Eindhoven), Jorrel Hato (Chelsea), Jurrien Timber (Arsenal), Micky van de Ven (Tottenham Hotspur), Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool), Jan Paul van Hecke (Tottenham Hotspur)
Meio-campistas: Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool), Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), Tijjani Reijnders (Al-Qadsiah), Kenneth Taylor (Lazio), Quinten Timber (Crystal Palace), Joey Veerman (Borussia Dortmund), Gjivai Zechiel (Feyenoord).
Atacantes: Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth), Ruben van Bommel (PSV Eindhoven), Brian Brobbey (Sunderland), Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), Noa Lang (Napoli), Donyell Malen (AS Roma), Crysencio Summerville (Al Hilal).

Les dirigeants de l'Allemagne, du Danemark, de la Finlande, des Pays-Bas et de l'Autriche demandent vendredi dans une tribune commune que le budget de l'Union européenne pour la période 2028-2034 soit inférieur de "plusieurs centaines de milliards d'euros" au montant proposé par la Commission européenne.
La Commission a proposé que le budget s'élève à [USN:L8N3TD1CS TEXT:"2.000 milliards d'euros"], soit 1,26% du revenu national brut (RNB) de l'UE - dont environ 168 milliards, soit 0,11%, seraient destinés au service de la dette contractée pour le fonds de relance post-pandémie.
Dans leur tribune publiée dans Politico, les responsables allemand, danois, finlandais, néerlandais et autrichien qualifient l’augmentation nominale proposée, d’environ 60% par rapport au budget 2021-2027, de "simplement pas réaliste".
"Il (le budget) est trop axé sur des subventions et des transferts alloués en grande partie à l’avance, laissant trop peu de place à ce dont l’Europe a un besoin urgent : des investissements communs dans la sécurité et la défense, la compétitivité, l’innovation et la lutte contre l’immigration clandestine", estiment-ils.
Les bénéficiaires nets du budget craignent que cela ne réduise les fonds destinés aux agriculteurs et à l’égalisation des niveaux de vie entre les régions les plus pauvres et les plus riches d’Europe.
L’Espagne a proposé de modifier le calendrier de remboursement d’une partie de l’emprunt de l’UE destiné à la relance, en le liant à la croissance économique et en l’étalant sur une période plus longue. Selon le ministre espagnol de l’Économie, Carlos Cuerpo, cela permettrait de dégager environ 70 milliards d’euros.
"Un versement annuel d’environ 0,06% du PIB de l’UE permettrait de rembourser la dette d’ici 2058, date butoir convenue par les États membres", a-t-il déclaré.
Les gouvernements de l’UE discuteront du prochain budget lors de sommets prévus en octobre, novembre et décembre, dans le but de parvenir à un accord avant la fin de l’année.
