items.title: Enviado de Putin y el AfD preparan negociación para que Alemania vuelva a recibir gas ruso: fuentes
items.author: John O'Donnell
items.creator: John O'Donnell
items.summary: El principal enviado económico del presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, y los líderes del partido de extrema derecha alemán AfD comenzaron los preparativos para reunirse el año que viene con el fin de debatir la reanudación del suministro de gas a la mayor economía de Europa, dijeron dos personas al tanto del plan.
items.body:
El principal enviado económico del presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, y los líderes del partido de extrema derecha alemán AfD comenzaron los preparativos para reunirse el año que viene con el fin de debatir la reanudación del suministro de gas a la mayor economía de Europa, dijeron dos personas al tanto del plan.
Las conversaciones para celebrar una reunión ya en marzo ponen de relieve las estrechas relaciones entre Moscú y el partido Alternativa para Alemania (AfD, por sus siglas en alemán), que, aunque una coalición de sus rivales le impide llegar al poder, es el partido más popular entre el electorado alemán.
A la reunión asistirían Kirill Dmitriev, asesor de confianza de Putin y director del fondo soberano ruso, así como los colíderes del AfD, Alice Weidel y Tino Chrupalla, dijo una de las fuentes.
Un portavoz del AfD y un representante de Dmitriev se negaron a hacer comentarios.
Antes de las sanciones impuestas por la invasión a gran escala de Ucrania por parte de Moscú en 2022, Rusia suministraba más de un tercio de las importaciones de petróleo crudo de Alemania y más de la mitad de su gas natural.
La reunión solo se celebraría si primero se acuerda un marco de paz entre Rusia y Ucrania, y los organizadores esperaban que reuniera al AfD, Rusia y Estados Unidos, según la misma fuente. Entre los posibles lugares para la cumbre se barajaban Israel, los Emiratos Árabes Unidos o la India, añadió.
Weidel abogó por el fin del boicot al petróleo y al gas rusos para reforzar la economía alemana, que se encuentra en declive, en una entrevista concedida a Reuters en junio.
Dmitriev estuvo presente en una reunión celebrada este mes en Moscú con los representantes estadounidenses Steve Witkoff y Jared Kushner.
Los organizadores esperaban que Witkoff y Kushner también asistieran a la reunión sobre el gas, en la que se estudiaría la reapertura de los gasoductos rusos Nord Stream, según la misma fuente.
Un funcionario estadounidense de alto rango dijo a Reuters que ni Witkoff ni Kushner han sido informados ni invitados a la cumbre propuesta.
EL AfD ESPERA GANARSE A LOS VOTANTES
Cualquier reunión tendría un carácter simbólico, ya que el AfD no forma parte del Gobierno. Sin embargo, los preparativos ponen de relieve la fragilidad del sistema político alemán, donde la tradicional negativa de los partidos mayoritarios a colaborar con la extrema derecha se ve puesta a prueba por el éxito electoral del AfD.
El AfD acaba de obtener una importante victoria al convertirse en el partido más votado en las elecciones regionales de Sajonia-Anhalt, y se enfrenta a otra prueba de su popularidad el domingo en las elecciones del estado de Mecklemburgo-Pomerania Occidental. Los gasoductos rusos Nord Stream entran en Alemania por este estado.
La Cámara de Comercio Americana en Moscú acogió la idea como "un paso positivo y oportuno".
"La participación de Alemania, como economía clave de Europa, puede crear una plataforma más amplia para debatir cuestiones que son importantes tanto para estos países como para el resto del mundo", dijo Robert Agee, presidente de AmCham Rusia.
Alemania ha tenido dificultades para recuperarse del impacto causado por el cierre de los importantes gasoductos submarinos Nord Stream, algunos de los cuales quedaron inutilizados por las explosiones de septiembre de 2022.
Sin embargo, cualquier intento de reanudar el suministro de gas ruso o de poner en marcha de nuevo Nord Stream provocaría una fuerte resistencia, tanto en Alemania como entre sus aliados, especialmente en Europa del Este.
"Alemania no puede volver a depender de Rusia", dijo Michael Kellner, diputado de Los Verdes que estuvo a cargo de la política energética alemana en el Gobierno durante la crisis desencadenada por el corte del gas ruso tras la invasión de Ucrania.
"No podemos repetir los errores de la crisis energética", añadió. "Nos costó 50.000 millones de euros. No podemos querer volver a eso. Sería una traición. Putin está utilizando al AfD para sus propios fines".
Roderich Kiesewetter, diputado del Partido Demócrata Cristiano del canciller Friedrich Merz, señaló que la reunión del AfD podría envalentonar a aquellos miembros de su partido que también se mostraban a favor de comprar gas ruso.
"El AfD está del lado de Rusia, dispuesto a traicionar tanto a Ucrania como a Alemania. Rusia utiliza la energía, especialmente el Nord Stream, como arma híbrida con fines militares. Reabrir el Nord Stream sería un desastre para la seguridad europea y aislaría a Alemania".
El AfD ha presentado su petición de reanudar los suministros de gas ruso como una medida pragmática, y Weidel ha descrito la "energía barata de Rusia" como "el secreto del éxito del 'Made in Germany'".
El AfD espera que la reunión sirva para demostrar su competencia en política exterior y poner de manifiesto la inacción del Gobierno a la hora de abordar los elevados precios de la energía, dijo una de las fuentes.
El apoyo de Alemania a Ucrania se ha convertido en un tema cada vez más divisivo.
La relación del país con Rusia tiene más peso en el este, que estuvo bajo dominio soviético hasta la caída del Muro de Berlín hace más de 35 años. Muchos de sus habitantes adoptan una postura comprensiva hacia Rusia y una visión crítica del protector militar de Alemania, Estados Unidos.

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: L'attaquant de l'équipe de France Kylian Mbappé quitte Nike pour devenir ambassadeur de la marque de sport On, a annoncé vendredi l'entreprise suisse, qui fait son entrée sur le marché du football.
items.body:
L'attaquant de l'équipe de France Kylian Mbappé quitte Nike pour devenir ambassadeur de la marque de sport On, a annoncé vendredi l'entreprise suisse, qui fait son entrée sur le marché du football.
On, qui, à l'instar d'autres marques émergentes, a grignoté des parts de marché à Nike, prévoit de lancer ses premières chaussures de football en 2027, a indiqué la société.
L'équipementier On a également annoncé un partenariat avec Thierry Henry en tant que "directeur du football".

items.title: TAUX Le "spread" entre le Bund et l'OAT à 10 ans atteint 100 pdb pour la première fois depuis 2012
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le "spread", ou écart de rendement entre l'obligations allemandes et françaises à 10 ans dépasse vendredi les 100 points de base (pdb), une première depuis 2012, à un moment où le marché subissait encore les conséquences de la crise financière mondiale de 2008-2011.
items.body:
Le "spread", ou écart de rendement entre l'obligations allemandes et françaises à 10 ans dépasse vendredi les 100 points de base (pdb), une première depuis 2012, à un moment où le marché subissait encore les conséquences de la crise financière mondiale de 2008-2011.
Cet écart, qui s'établit à 103 points de base à 12h20 GMT, permet de mesurer la prime exigée par les investisseurs pour détenir la dette française par rapport à celle de Berlin, et fait l'objet d'une attention particulière sur fond d'inquiétudes budgétaires dans la deuxième économie de la zone euro.
Le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu [USN:L8N4591JE TEXT:"a annoncé"] jeudi des économies de l'ordre de 54 milliards d'euros dans le projet de budget 2027 pour la France, tout en signalant que l'objectif de ramener le déficit à 5% du PIB ne serait pas atteint cette année comme prévu, mais la prochaine.
Les tensions qui touchent la dette souveraine française surviennent dans un contexte de tensions générales sur les marchés obligataires mondiaux, les craintes liées à la dette et au conflit au Moyen-Orient impactant l'Europe et au-delà.
En Italie, le ministre de l'Économie, Giancarlo Giorgetti, a déclaré vendredi que le coût de la dette publique du pays augmentait à un rythme alarmant dans le contexte des tensions géopolitiques.
"J'ai transmis un message concernant les rendements, ou plutôt concernant le poids de la dette, qui a commencé à augmenter à un rythme alarmant", a-t-il déclaré par visioconférence en marge d'une réunion de ministres de Finances de la zone euro qui se tient à Dublin.
Le rendement des BTP italiens à 3 ans a atteint son plus haut niveau depuis juin 2024, à 3,43%, tandis que les BTP à 7 ans ont touché un pic depuis novembre 2023.
Kyriakos Pierrakakis, président de l'Eurogroupe, a toutefois tenu à rassurer lors d'une conférence de presse dans la capitale irlandaise.
"Je dirais que nous sommes préoccupés, mais pas inquiets. Nous ne constatons pas de fragmentation au sein de la zone euro", a-t-il souligné.
Le commissaire européen à l'Économie, Valdis Dombrovskis, également présent à Dublin, a déclaré pour sa part que la hausse des rendements constituait une réaction normale du marché face aux évolutions mondiales et ne faisait que souligner la nécessité de maintenir des politiques budgétaires prudentes.
Les États-Unis ne sont pas non plus épargnés par les tensions sur les marchés obligataires.
Le rendement de référence des bons du Trésor américain à dix ans a dépassé le seuil psychologique des 5%, s'établissant à 5,041% en début de semaine, son plus haut niveau depuis juillet 2007.

items.title: Jana urges Cooper to replace CEO, explore asset sales after performance setbacks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Activist investor Jana Partners on Friday urged Cooper Companies to launch an external search for a new CEO and consider asset sales, arguing recent missteps have hurt investor confidence and weighed on the medical device maker's market value.
items.body:
Activist investor Jana Partners on Friday urged Cooper Companies (COO.O) to launch an external search for a new CEO and consider asset sales, arguing recent missteps have hurt investor confidence and weighed on the medical device maker's market value.
Cooper had [USN:L4N4511U9 TEXT:"lowered its annual forecasts"] last week and ended a review of options for its CooperSurgical unit without a sale.
Here are more details:
Jana asked Cooper to engage potential buyers for its contact lens unit, CooperVision, and consider a sale of fertility and medical device businesses within its CooperSurgical unit.
Cooper did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
The activist investor owns about 3.58 million shares, or 1.8% stake, in Cooper, according to its latest regulatory filing.
JANA is also calling for a new board chair and the addition of directors with expertise to strengthen oversight of the company.
Jana urged Cooper to link executive pay more closely to performance to boost accountability.
It also criticized Cooper's handling of excess inventory held by customers of CooperVision.
Jana said Cooper's shares have lagged peers and trade at a discount to comparable companies.
Shares have fallen about 21% over the past 12 months, compared with gains of about 19% for Becton Dickinson and 61% for Integer Holdings and a decline of about 17% for Alcon, according to data compiled by LSEG.
The investor also urged Cooper to hire an outside adviser to identify manufacturing and supply-chain cost savings at CooperVision.

items.title: Fundação Nobel aumenta valor do prêmio de cada categoria para US$1,2 milhão
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Fundação Nobel da Suécia anunciou nesta sexta-feira que aumentará em 9% o valor do prêmio deste ano para seus prestigiosos prêmios anuais, chegando a um valor total de 12 milhões de coroas suecas (US$1,22 milhão) em cada uma das seis categorias.
items.body:
A Fundação Nobel da Suécia anunciou nesta sexta-feira que aumentará em 9% o valor do prêmio deste ano para seus prestigiosos prêmios anuais, chegando a um valor total de 12 milhões de coroas suecas (US$1,22 milhão) em cada uma das seis categorias.
“Ao aumentar o valor do prêmio, preservamos a importância de longo prazo do Prêmio Nobel e garantimos que a parte financeira do prêmio mantenha seu valor ao longo do tempo”, afirmou Hanna Stjarne, diretora executiva da Fundação Nobel, em comunicado.
Os vencedores dos prêmios deste ano nas categorias de Física, Química, Paz, Literatura, Economia e Medicina ou Fisiologia serão anunciados entre 5 e 12 de outubro, marcando o 125º aniversário da primeira cerimônia de premiação.
Criados pelo testamento do empresário sueco do Século 19 Alfred Nobel, inventor da dinamite, os primeiros prêmios, em 1901, foram de 150.782 coroas por categoria, segundo a fundação.
(Reportagem de Louise Rasmussen)

items.title: France's Macron says G7 will meet to discuss energy crisis in coming weeks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: President Emmanuel Macron said on Friday a meeting of G7 countries would take place in the coming weeks to step up cooperation among members and help secure supplies in the face of the current energy crisis stemming from the Iran war.
items.body:
President Emmanuel Macron said on Friday a meeting of G7 countries would take place in the coming weeks to step up cooperation among members and help secure supplies in the face of the current energy crisis stemming from the Iran war.
"In the coming weeks, we will hold a G7 meeting dedicated to these energy issues, both to strengthen cooperation and avoid unnecessary tensions among G7 countries and our key partners, and to consider options for potential releases from strategic reserves or the lifting of restrictions, as we did a few months ago," Macron told a news conference.
Macron, whose government faces growing protests and pressure over high fuel prices, was hosting a meeting with the chiefs of different political parties represented in parliament to discuss the crises in the Middle East and Ukraine and their consequences on the energy market.

items.title: UK air traffic control outage caused by software defect, says operator
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British air traffic control operator NATS said on Friday an outage which affected hundreds of thousands of passengers last week was cause by a software defect.
items.body:
British air traffic control operator NATS said on Friday an [USN:L8N4510B4 TEXT:"outage"] which affected hundreds of thousands of passengers last week was cause by a software defect.
The incident led to 2,000 flight cancellations and days of disruption, costing airlines millions of pounds as they scrambled to get crews and aircraft back in place and refund passengers.
NATS CEO Martin Rolfe said the shutdown was not related to a problem in 2023 which also caused widespread disruption, nor was it linked to military intervention - as reported by some media outlets last week. He added that safety was at no point compromised during the incident.
"This was a software issue in a specific part of our flight data system, that we have traced to a small subsection of coding," he said. "The issue has been identified and mitigation is in place while a permanent fix is safety tested and deployed."
Transport minister Heidi Alexander, who had last week demanded NATS produce a report on the matter and also ordered an independent review by the Civil Aviation Authority, said the disruption was "completely unacceptable".
"We need to urgently understand why this issue was not discovered and fixed before it caused chaos," she said in a statement. "It is crucial that our national infrastructure is fit for the future."
The incident followed a shutdown in August 2023 which caused travel chaos, costing airlines £100 million ($136 million). A smaller technical issue which NATS was behind in July 2025 also caused 150 cancellations.
Ryanair (RYA.I) , Europe's biggest airline, has repeatedly for Rolfe to resign since the 2023 failure.
The NATS report on the latest incident was triggered by a request for an identification code from an aircraft being followed by a request for a higher priority activity, pausing the first request.
"Had the higher-priority request arrived even one millisecond earlier or later, the update would have completed normally," the report said.

items.title: ULTIM'ORA-UCRAINA: Francia minacciata da attacchi ibridi russi nelle ultime settimane - Macron
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
items.body:
Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sul conflitto in corso in Ucraina:
14.30 - La Francia è stata minacciata da attacchi ibridi russi nelle ultime settimane, ha detto il presidente Emmanuel Macron.
"Nelle ultime settimane si è intensificata la minaccia, in particolare quella ibrida proveniente dalla Russia, che grava sugli europei e sulla Francia", ha detto Macron ai giornalisti dopo aver incontrato a Parigi i leader dei partiti politici per discutere dei recenti sviluppi della situazione internazionale.
11.10 - Kiev ha ricevuto una tranche di 3,3 miliardi di euro nell'ambito del prestito dell'Unione europea Ukraine Support Loan.
Lo ha detto il primo ministro Sergii Koretskyi.
L’Ucraina destinerà i fondi alle esigenze prioritarie in materia di difesa, in particolare all’acquisto di missili e droni, ha spiegato Koretskyi sull’app di messaggistica Telegram.
9.55 - Sono iniziate le votazioni per le elezioni parlamentari in Russia, che si svolgeranno nell'arco di tre giorni e che il presidente Vladimir Putin ha presentato come un barometro del consenso popolare attorno alla guerra in Ucraina.
Si tratta del primo appuntamento elettorale parlamentare da quando, nel febbraio 2022, la Russia ha cominciato la sua guerra contro Kiev. Il voto, che determinerà la composizione dei 450 seggi della camera bassa del parlamento — la Duma di Stato — dovrebbe confermare il predominio del partito filoputiniano Russia Unita, in un sistema politico tenuto sotto stretto controllo.
La maggior parte dei candidati contrari alla guerra è stata esclusa dalle liste dopo che la Corte Suprema ha stabilito che il partito liberale Yabloko — favorevole a un cessate il fuoco — aveva violato le norme elettorali. Alcuni candidati restano tuttavia in corsa nei collegi uninominali.
Il voto arriva in un momento in cui i sondaggi segnalano un crescente senso di preoccupazione tra i russi riguardo all'impatto del conflitto sulle loro vite.
L'economia è sotto pressione e le autorità puntano a sfruttare queste elezioni per misurare la stanchezza dei cittadini nei confronti della guerra. Alcune regioni del Paese sono infatti alle prese con carenze di carburante causate dai droni ucraini, mentre le imprese faticano a far fronte agli alti tassi d'interesse, alla scarsità di manodopera e alle sanzioni occidentali.

items.title: POINT MARCHÉS Wall Street vue dans le désordre, l'Europe pénalisée par les rendements
items.author: Diana Mandia
items.creator: Diana Mandia
items.summary: Wall Street est attendue en ordre dispersé et les Bourses européennes reculent vendredi à mi-séance, pénalisées par une nouvelle remontée des rendements obligataires après une semaine marquée par le resserrement monétaire des principales banques centrales.
items.body:
Wall Street est attendue en ordre dispersé et les Bourses européennes reculent vendredi à mi-séance, pénalisées par une nouvelle remontée des rendements obligataires après une semaine marquée par le resserrement monétaire des principales banques centrales.
Les futures sur indices new-yorkais signalent une ouverture de Wall Street en baisse de 0,10% le Dow Jones (.DJI) , stable pour le Standard & Poor's-500 (.SPX) et en hausse de 0,35% pour le Nasdaq.
À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) perd 1,04% à 8.101,45 points vers 12h05 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) recule de 0,99% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) cède 0,98%.
L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) recule de 1,13%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,79% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,76%.
La progression des rendements obligataires pèse à nouveau sur les marchés d'actions, les craintes inflationnistes restant élevées malgré un léger répit sur les cours du pétrole, avec les marchés anticipant désormais entre trois et quatre nouvelles hausses des taux d'intérêt par la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) pour freiner la tendance.
Les consommateurs de la zone euro ont légèrement [USN:L6N45A0J0 TEXT:"revu à la hausse"] leurs anticipations d'inflation le mois dernier, selon une enquête de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) publiée vendredi, tandis que les prix à la production en Allemagne [USN:L8N45A06I TEXT:"ont progressé"] beaucoup plus prévu en août.
La présidente de la BCE, Christine Lagarde a toutefois souligné vendredi que les taux n'évoluaient pas au rythme des prix du pétrole et du gaz, ce qui tempère l'approche plutôt agressive que les marchés anticipent concernant la politique monétaire de Francfort.
"Les taux d'intérêt n'évoluent pas au rythme des prix de l'énergie car, bien évidemment, ces derniers et leur incidence sur les prix ont également un impact sur d'autres facteurs, notamment la croissance et la consommation, et nous prenons en compte tous ces éléments", a déclaré Christine Lagarde lors d'une conférence de presse à Dublin.
Les mesures de politique monétaire ont été au centre de l'attention cette semaine et ont envoyé un message de fermeté aux marchés face à une inflation persistante.
La Réserve fédérale américaine (Fed) a annoncé mercredi sa première hausse des taux depuis plus de trois ans et prévoit un relèvement supplémentaire cette année, rassurant toutefois les investisseurs quant à l'indépendance de la banque centrale vis-à-vis de la Maison blanche.
La [USN:L8N45A0GD TEXT:"Banque du Japon"] (BoJ) a également relevé vendredi ses taux, comme largement anticipé par les marchés, même l'absence d'orientations explicitement "hawkish" pèse sur la devise nippone.
La Banque d'Angleterre (BoE) a pour sa part laissé son taux directeur inchangé jeudi, mais a laissé la porte ouverte à un relèvement si le conflit au Moyen-Orient venait à se prolonger.
Les inquiétudes budgétaires restent en outre vives dans des pays comme la France et exercent une pression accrue sur le marché de la dette souveraine.
Le "spread", ou écart de rendement entre les obligations allemandes et françaises à 10 ans a atteint vendredi les 100 points de base (pdb), une première depuis 2012, à un moment où le marché subissait encore les conséquences de la crise financière mondiale de 2008-2011.
Cet écart, qui permet de mesurer la prime exigée par les investisseurs pour détenir la dette française par rapport à celle de Berlin, fait l'objet d'une attention particulière depuis des années, en raison des crises politiques et budgétaires successives de la deuxième économie de la zone euro, et d'autant plus aujourd'hui que le processus budgétaire pour 2027 approche à grands pas.
LES VALEURS À SUIVRE À WALL STREET [USN:L8N45A0N1]
VALEURS EN EUROPE Lanterne rouge du CAC 40, l'opérateur français Orange (ORAN.PA) perd 5,1% à la suite d'un abaissement de recommandation par Morgan Stanley.
Le spécialiste des soins pour animaux Virbac (VIRB.PA) recule de 2,2% au lendemain de la publication de ses résultats.
Ailleurs en Europe, Nestlé (NESN.S) cède 2,2 après [USN:L8N459268 TEXT:"la décision"] du Kremlin de transférer les actifs du groupe agroalimentaire suisse dans le pays à des sociétés russes.
TAUX Les craintes inflationnistes font progresser les rendements obligataires des deux bords de l'Atlantique.
Aux Etats-Unis, le rendement des Treasuries à dix ans prend 2 points de base à 4,9673%. Le deux ans gagne 3 points de base à 4,7197%.
Dans la zone euro, le rendement du Bund allemand à dix ans avance de 2 points de base à 3,4995% après avoir atteint son plus haut niveau depuis juin 2009 mardi dernier. Le deux ans gagne 4,4 points de base à 3,2576%.
En France, le rendement de l'OAT à dix ans avance de 7,5 points de base à 4,5214%, proche des 4,5531% atteints en début de semaine.
Le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu a annoncé jeudi des économies de l'ordre de 54 milliards d'euros dans le projet de budget 2027 pour la France, tout en signalant que l'objectif de ramener le déficit à 5% du PIB ne serait pas atteint cette année comme prévu, mais la prochaine.
CHANGES Le dollar gagne 0,28% face à un panier de devises de référence (.DXY) , soutenu par les craintes inflationnistes et les anticipations d'une politique monétaire plus ferme de la part de la Fed.
L'euro perd à son tour 0,15% pour s'établir à 1,1457 dollar .
Le yen recule de 1,2% à 157,88 pour un dollar.
"La BoJ a renoué avec une (pas si) vieille tradition avec un net revirement de communication qui s'est répercuté sur la devise,laquelle a déjà effacé une bonne part de son appréciation récente face au dollar", écrit Jean-Thomas Heissat, stratégiste chez CRAMP.
PÉTROLE Le Brent perd 1,45% à 103,30 dollars le baril et le brut léger américain (West Texas Intermediate, WTI) cède 0,43% à 101,47 dollars.
Les inquiétudes concernant l'impact de l'escalade entre l'Arabie saoudite et les Houthis sur l'approvisionnement restent d'actualité.

items.title: Russland startet dreitägige Parlamentswahl im Schatten von Ukraine-Krieg
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: In Russland läuft die erste Parlamentswahl seit Beginn des Angriffskriegs gegen die Ukraine im Februar 2022. Es wird allgemein erwartet, dass die kremltreue Partei Geeintes Russland bei der am Freitag begonnenen dreitägigen Abstimmung ihre Dominanz im streng kontrollierten politischen System des Landes behaupten wird. Präsident Wladimir Putin erklärte in einer Fernsehansprache vor der Abstimmung, die Wahl werde die Unterstützung der Bevölkerung für das Militär demonstrieren.
items.body:
In Russland läuft die erste Parlamentswahl seit Beginn des Angriffskriegs gegen die Ukraine im Februar 2022. Es wird allgemein erwartet, dass die kremltreue Partei Geeintes Russland bei der am Freitag begonnenen dreitägigen Abstimmung ihre Dominanz im streng kontrollierten politischen System des Landes behaupten wird. Präsident Wladimir Putin erklärte in einer Fernsehansprache vor der Abstimmung, die Wahl werde die Unterstützung der Bevölkerung für das Militär demonstrieren.
"Ihre Entscheidung und Ihr Wille werden einmal mehr zeigen, dass Millionen von Menschen hinter unseren Soldaten stehen, dass wir ein geeintes Volk sind, das durch gemeinsame Werte, ein gemeinsames historisches Bewusstsein und die Liebe zu unserer Heimat verbunden ist, und dass es niemandem gelingen wird, uns zu spalten oder einzuschüchtern", sagte Putin. Die staatlichen Medien begleiten die Wahl mit einer intensiven Kampagne. Im Staatsfernsehen rief ein Werbespot zur Stimmabgabe auf, der historische russische Militärführer zeigte und mit Aufnahmen von Soldaten in der Ukraine endete. Der Slogan lautete: "Ihre Stimme ist die Stimme des Sieges. Ihre Stimme ist die Stärke Russlands!"
In der Bevölkerung herrschen Sorgen über eine neue Mobilisierungswelle nach der Wahl, was die Behörden wiederholt zurückgewiesen haben. "Es gibt einige sehr düstere Prognosen und andere, die optimistischer sind", sagte der 76-jährige Anatoli Simonenko in Moskau der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Ich erwarte, dass das Ergebnis irgendwo in der Mitte liegen wird. Krieg ist Krieg. Er bringt Ausgaben, Verteidigungsausgaben und Kürzungen bei verschiedenen Sozialleistungen mit sich. Das ist notwendig, daran führt kein Weg vorbei." Ein anderer Wähler, der anonym bleiben wollte, äußerte Zweifel an der Zuverlässigkeit der elektronischen Stimmabgabe und befürchtete Manipulationen. Die Wahlkommission wies solche Vorwürfe als falsch zurück.
MEHRHEIT WILL FRIEDENSVERHANDLUNGEN Die meisten Kandidaten, die sich gegen den Krieg aussprechen, wurden von der Wahl ausgeschlossen. Der Oberste Gerichtshof hatte vergangenen Monat entschieden, dass die liberale Jabloko-Partei, die einen Waffenstillstand in der Ukraine fordert, gegen Wahlvorschriften verstoßen habe. Die Partei wies dies zurück. Dennoch treten einige Jabloko-Kandidaten in einzelnen Wahlkreisen an, in denen die Hälfte der insgesamt 450 Sitze im Unterhaus vergeben wird.
Die Repressionen gegen die Opposition wurden im Vorfeld der Wahl verschärft. Lew Schlosberg, ein führendes Mitglied von Jabloko, wurde wegen Äußerungen über den Krieg zu elf Jahren Haft verurteilt. Der stellvertretende Parteivorsitzende Maxim Kruglow war im Juni zu sieben Jahren Gefängnis verurteilt worden. Die Diskreditierung der Armee oder die Verbreitung von Informationen, die die Behörden als falsch einstufen, wird in Russland mit langen Haftstrafen geahndet.
Umfragen zufolge befürworten inzwischen mehr als 60 Prozent der russischen Bevölkerung Friedensverhandlungen. Der Kreml erklärte wiederholt, zu Gesprächen bereit zu sein. Gleichzeitig fordert Moskau jedoch die vollständige Kontrolle über die ostukrainische Region Donezk und strebt eine langfristige Vereinbarung anstelle eines bloßen Waffenstillstands an.
Wegen des Krieges gerät die russische Wirtschaft zunehmend in Bedrängnis. Treibstoffengpässe nach ukrainischen Drohnenangriffen auf Ölraffinerien, Attacken auf Lagerhäuser, hohe Zinssätze, Arbeitskräftemangel und westliche Sanktionen belasten das Land zunehmend. Der Kreml betonte, die nationale Einheit sei angesichts von Sabotageversuchen ukrainischer Geheimdienste unerlässlich. Erste Teilergebnisse der Wahl werden am Sonntagabend erwartet, ein nahezu vollständiges Ergebnis soll am Montag vorliegen.

items.title: India likely to discuss second half borrowing on Sept. 25, sources say
items.author: Dharamraj Dhutia, Shubham Batra
items.creator: Dharamraj Dhutia, Shubham Batra
items.summary: India's government officials are likely to meet next Friday to finalise the borrowing calendar for the second half of the fiscal year ending in March, two sources familiar with the matter said.
items.body:
India's government officials are likely to meet next Friday to finalise the borrowing calendar for the second half of the fiscal year ending in March, two sources familiar with the matter said.
An announcement is expected after the meeting.
New Delhi plans to raise 16.09 trillion rupees ($167.92 billion) through bond sales this fiscal year and has borrowed 7.79 trillion rupees so far, with the final first-half auction, worth 340 billion rupees due next Friday.
That leaves 7.96 trillion rupees of gross borrowing for October-March, including 65 billion rupees not raised at a three-year bond auction on September 11.
In consultations with market participants ahead of the borrowing plan, a regular practice, most investors favoured increasing the share of shorter-dated three-year and five-year bonds, one of the above mentioned source and two traders, who could not be named because they are not authorised to speak to media, said.
However, the Reserve Bank of India's subsequent decision to conduct open market bond sales has complicated that preference, traders added.
"Open market sales were not on the minds of the majority during those meetings, but they are now a bitter reality," one of the traders said. "Increasing supply in that segment could distort the yield curve and push up short-term borrowing costs."
The RBI has announced bond sales to drain record banking-system liquidity after dollar inflows from diaspora deposits far exceeded estimates.
Market participants also recommended reducing 10-year bond issuance or splitting supply between two alternate-week auctions instead of one sale every four weeks.
The RBI sold 340 billion rupees of 10-year bonds every four weeks between April and September, accounting for 29% of total issuance.
The share of three- and five-year bonds rose to 23.5% in April-September from 16.6% a year earlier.
Meanwhile some market participants had suggested increasing the share of ultra-long bonds with maturities of 30 to 50 years, which had been cut to about 25% of total borrowing, from 35% a year earlier.
Investors will also focus on the auction size of ultra-short Treasury bills, which have seen stronger demand as compared to dated securities, amid expectations the left-out 65-billion-rupee borrowing to be a part of this plan.
($1 = 95.8200 Indian rupees)

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
items.body:
Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
14.20 - Il ministro della Difesa Guido Crosetto ha chiesto una maggiore presenza navale nel Mar Rosso per proteggere i mercantili, alla luce delle preoccupazioni relative allo Stretto di Bab el-Mandeb.
L’Italia, che fa parte della missione Aspides dell’Unione Europea avviata nel 2024 per proteggere la navigazione dagli attacchi degli Houthi, ieri ha dichiarato di stare preparando una missione navale nell’area non potendo attendere che l’Ue risponda alla nuova crisi.
Crosetto ha detto a Reuters che dopo le dichiarazioni di ieri qualcosa si è mosso nell'ambito di Aspides, ma servono più navi.
Le uniche nazioni che sostengono realmente gli sforzi di sicurezza sono l’Italia e la Grecia, ha detto Crosetto, senza fornire una stima di quante navi sarebbero necessarie per garantire la sicurezza dell’area.

items.body:
A Rússia pede que o Japão retire de seu território os sistemas de mísseis Typhon dos EUA, disse na sexta-feira a agência de notícias estatal TASS, citando a porta-voz do Ministério das Relações Exteriores, Maria Zakharova.
Moscou protestou repetidamente contra a implantação do Typhon durante os exercícios conjuntos realizados neste mês entre Japão, Austrália e Estados Unidos, alegando que isso representa uma ameaça à segurança russa.
Zakharova referiu-se a uma nota de protesto enviada em 3 de setembro, afirmando que o Japão deveria levá-la muito a sério.
O Typhon é um sistema de mísseis de médio alcance capaz de lançar mísseis de cruzeiro SM-6 e Tomahawk .
A Rússia e o Japão trocaram uma série de protestos nas últimas semanas, após uma rara visita do presidente Vladimir Putin a uma ilha disputada controlada pela Rússia, localizada a nordeste do Japão.

items.title: Lagarde refuta expectativas do mercado de alta nos juros após aumento nos custos da energia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As taxas de juros do Banco Central Europeu não estão se movendo em sintonia com os preços do petróleo e do gás, afirmou nesta sexta-feira a presidente do BCE, Christine Lagarde, refutando as apostas do mercado de aumentos agressivos nos juros em resposta à alta dos custos de energia.
items.body:
As taxas de juros do Banco Central Europeu não estão se movendo em sintonia com os preços do petróleo e do gás, afirmou nesta sexta-feira a presidente do BCE, Christine Lagarde, refutando as apostas do mercado de aumentos agressivos nos juros em resposta à alta dos custos de energia.
“As taxas de juros não acompanham diretamente o preço da energia porque, obviamente, o preço da energia e seu impacto sobre os preços também afetam outros fatores, incluindo, notadamente, o crescimento e o consumo, e levamos todos esses elementos em consideração”, disse Lagarde em uma coletiva de imprensa em Dublin.
Os comentários foram feitos poucas horas depois que o vice-presidente do BCE, Boris Vujcic, também pareceu moderar as expectativas dos investidores, argumentando que o BCE analisará um conjunto muito mais amplo de indicadores econômicos ao decidir seus próximos passos.
Os mercados financeiros agora veem entre três e quatro novos aumentos nos juros no próximo ano, além dos dois dos últimos meses, já que tanto os preços do petróleo quanto os do gás estão próximos do cenário “adverso” do BCE e podem elevar a inflação para perto de 4% até o final do ano.
Em outra possível indicação de que os mercados podem estar esperando demais do BCE, Lagarde afirmou que o banco central ainda se encontra em uma situação em que uma resposta “moderada” é suficiente para conter o problema da inflação no bloco.
“Estamos adotando uma resposta calculada à situação atual”, acrescentou Lagarde. “Acreditamos que estamos bem posicionados para responder a mais dados, mais informações, mais números, a fim de fazer uma boa avaliação das mudanças.”
Lagarde também minimizou as preocupações com o aumento dos custos dos empréstimos dos governos e disse que essas altas refletem principalmente eventos globais, e não questões locais.
“Não vemos nenhum movimento desordenado”, disse ela. “Não vemos nenhuma tensão... trata-se de um movimento global que afeta todos os títulos, especialmente na parte longa da curva, por diversas razões, mas sem nenhum comportamento desordenado.”
(Reportagem de Balazs Koranyi)

items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Denmark is speeding up a donation to Ukraine in response to a recent incident in which a Russian warship fired flares towards a Danish military helicopter, narrowly missing the aircraft, the Nordic country's government said on Friday.
items.body:
Denmark is speeding up a donation to Ukraine in response to a recent incident in which a Russian warship fired flares towards a Danish military helicopter, narrowly missing the aircraft, the Nordic country's government said on Friday.
Denmark [USN:L6N4570BV TEXT:"on Monday said"] a Russian frigate fired flares without warning at the helicopter as it sought to photograph the ship in international waters, while Moscow in response accused Denmark of carrying out dangerous manoeuvres near its vessel.
The new support package for Ukraine was worth an estimated 1.8 billion Danish crowns ($276 million) and will be used for air defences, the government said.
"If the Russians think they can rattle us... then our response is to ramp up our support for Ukraine faster than we had intended," Defence Minister Jeppe Bruus told reporters after a meeting with parliamentarians.
Denmark has been among Ukraine's most [USN:L6N3ZK10A TEXT:"vocal supporters"] since Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022 and is a leading provider of financial aid on a per-capita basis.
"If anyone thinks they can pressure us to hold back on our support for Ukraine, they are mistaken," Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen said.
($1 = 6.5228 Danish crowns)

items.title: Startup de IA Mantic levanta US$25 mi após superar humanos em previsões
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Mantic, uma empresa desenvolvedora de inteligência artificial que superou os humanos em uma competição recente de previsão de eventos, anunciou na sexta-feira que levantou US$25 milhões em financiamento inicial.
items.body:
A Mantic, uma empresa desenvolvedora de inteligência artificial que superou os humanos em uma competição recente de previsão de eventos, anunciou na sexta-feira que levantou US$25 milhões em financiamento inicial.
Os resultados da Metaculus Cup do verão de 2026, um torneio online de previsões que foi encerrado neste mês, mostraram que a startup sediada em Londres atribuiu probabilidades a acontecimentos políticos, econômicos e culturais com mais precisão do que os competidores humanos.
Seu desempenho e o de outros participantes de IA marcaram a primeira vez que a tecnologia dominou a competição.
Agora, a Radical Ventures liderou a rodada de financiamento da Mantic com uma avaliação não divulgada, contando com o apoio do fundo de investimentos M12, da Microsoft (MSFT.O) , da startup Thinking Machines Lab, da Balderton Capital e de outros investidores.
Em uma entrevista, o presidente-executivo da Mantic, Toby Shevlane, disse: “Estamos agora elevando o nível em que os humanos podem compreender o futuro.”
A Mantic atua especializando modelos de IA de ponta de outros laboratórios para que sejam mais precisos nas previsões. Ela testa seu sistema preditivo em dados históricos, avalia seu desempenho e, em seguida, o aprimora, explicou Shevlane, que cofundou a Mantic com Ben Day em 2024.
Shevlane disse que seu trabalho anterior como pesquisador científico no Google DeepMind, da Alphabet, deu origem à ideia, pois ele precisava de ajuda para prever eventos globais relevantes para a IA.
Na Metaculus Cup, uma vantagem que a Mantic tinha sobre os analistas humanos era evitar a mentalidade de rebanho, disse Shevlane. Em uma pergunta, os humanos apostaram de forma esmagadora que a música “Dai Dai”, da cantora Shakira, não ultrapassaria “Waka Waka” na Billboard Hot 100. Isso acabou se revelando errado, mas a Mantic não apostou fortemente no consenso, disse Shevlane.
No início do torneio, a Mantic também atribuiu a Abelardo De La Espriella cerca de 40% de chance de vencer a eleição presidencial da Colômbia, em comparação com uma previsão consensual de aproximadamente 30%, disse Shevlane. De La Espriella acabou vencendo. A Mantic superou todos os participantes humanos e todos os bots, exceto um chamado “laertes”, de acordo com os resultados.
Aaron Rosenberg, sócio da Radical Ventures que passou a integrar o conselho da Mantic, disse que a startup despertou o interesse de empresas e órgãos governamentais em todo o mundo, alguns dos quais já integraram sua IA. A Mantic se recusou a divulgar o nome de seus clientes.
Fundos de hedge e corretoras estavam particularmente interessados nas previsões da Mantic, disse Rosenberg.
“Se a Mantic é sobre-humana como é, eles podem lucrar com isso imediatamente”, disse ele.
(Reportagem de Jeffrey Dastin em San Francisco)

items.title: Bce, Lagarde smorza attese mercati su rialzi tassi dopo impennata prezzi energia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: I tassi di interesse della Banca centrale europea non si muovono automaticamente in linea con i prezzi del petrolio e del gas.
items.body:
I tassi di interesse della Banca centrale europea non si muovono automaticamente in linea con i prezzi del petrolio e del gas.
Lo ha detto la presidente della Bce Christine Lagarde, raffreddando le aspettative dei mercati su una serie di aggressivi rialzi dei tassi in risposta all'impennata dei costi energetici.
"I tassi di interesse non seguono un andamento parallelo a quello dei prezzi dell’energia perché, ovviamente, il prezzo dell’energia e il suo impatto sui prezzi influiscono anche su altri fattori, tra cui in particolare la crescita e i consumi, e noi teniamo conto di tutti questi elementi", ha detto Lagarde durante una conferenza stampa a Dublino.
Queste dichiarazioni arrivano a poche ore di distanza da quelle del vicepresidente della Bce Boris Vujcic, che a sua volta è sembrato voler smorzare le aspettative degli investitori, sostenendo che la Bce prenderà in considerazione una serie molto più ampia di indicatori economici nel decidere le prossime mosse di politica monetaria.
I mercati finanziari prevedono ora da tre a quattro ulteriori aumenti dei tassi nel corso del prossimo anno, oltre ai due già effettuati negli ultimi mesi, poiché sia i prezzi del petrolio che quelli del gas si avvicinano allo scenario "avverso" delineato dalla Bce e potrebbero spingere l’inflazione vicino al 4% entro la fine dell’anno.
In un ulteriore segnale che i mercati potrebbero aspettarsi troppo dall'istituto centrale, Lagarde ha detto che la Bce si trova ancora in una situazione in cui una risposta "misurata" è sufficiente per contenere le pressioni inflazionistiche nell'area euro.
"Stiamo adottando una risposta misurata alla situazione attuale", ha aggiunto Lagarde. "Riteniamo di essere ben posizionati per reagire a nuovi dati, ulteriori informazioni e elementi statistici, così da potere valutare correttamente i cambiamenti".
Lagarde ha inoltre minimizzato i timori relativi all’aumento dei costi dell'indebitamento pubblico, affermando che questi riflettono principalmente sviluppi globali, piuttosto che questioni locali.
"Non vediamo movimenti disordinati", ha affermato. "Non vediamo alcuna tensione, … si tratta di un movimento globale che interessa tutte le obbligazioni, e in particolare il tratto lungo della curva dei rendimenti, per molteplici ragioni, ma non si tratta di un andamento disordinato".

items.title: Back in first place, buoyed White Sox set to tackle Tigers again
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: After relinquishing first place in the American League Central for the first time in 10 weeks, the Chicago White Sox wasted little time returning to the top of the division.
items.body:
After relinquishing first place in the American League Central for the first time in 10 weeks, the Chicago White Sox wasted little time returning to the top of the division.
Chicago will try to remain steady on Friday night as a four-game series against the visiting Detroit Tigers continues.
Chicago (78-75) defeated Detroit 3-1 in Thursday's series opener to draw even with idle Cleveland atop the division. The White Sox hold the tiebreaker over the Guardians by winning the season series.
Chicago first baseman Munetaka Murakami went 2-for-4 with a three-run home run and a triple on Thursday to show signs of breaking out of a prolonged slump. Murakami was 5-for-52 (.096) with 31 strikeouts in September entering Thursday's game.
He hit his first home run since Sept. 9, his club-leading 32nd of the season, as Chicago regrouped. Wednesday's 6-3 loss to the Guardians dropped the White Sox out of first place for the first time since July 3.
"It's been awhile since I've been hitting home runs, and I've been disappointing the team all along," Murakami said through an interpreter, "so I'm really just glad to hit one off and help the team win."
Kevin McGonigle singled twice as the Tigers out-hit the White Sox 8-5. But Detroit registered just one extra-base hit, a Dillon Dingler double in the fifth inning.
Riley Greene extended his hitting streak to seven games for the Tigers and is batting .414 (12-of-29) in that span.
Detroit (72-81) has lost two games in a row on the heels of a six-game winning streak. The Tigers fell six games out of the final AL wild-card spot with nine to play.
Friday's pitching matchup will pit a pair of rookies as Detroit left-hander Andrew Sears (0-1, 5.40 ERA) faces Chicago right-hander David Sandlin (2-2, 5.64).
Sears has made four starts totaling just 16 2/3 innings, allowing 10 runs on 19 hits and four walks with 13 strikeouts.
Facing the Colorado Rockies on Saturday, he allowed four runs and seven hits in 4 1/3 innings with one walk, one hit batter and a career-high five strikeouts in his team's 11-7 victory. Sears said he remains determined to work through early adjustments, including dealing with gamesmanship displayed by batters who step out of the box at times.
"I am used to working fast," Sears said. "The pitch clock has never affected me, but it does work into the mind games with the hitters. They like to slow the game down, and I would like to keep going fast."
Recalled from Triple-A Charlotte on Sunday to start against the St. Louis Cardinals, Sandlin was perfect over the first 5 1/3 innings before faltering.
He recorded just one more out while giving up three unearned runs and two hits with five strikeouts. He took the loss in his first major league appearance since Aug. 7 as the White Sox fell 3-1.
Neither Sandlin nor Sears has faced Friday's opponent yet in their careers.
Chicago shortstop Colson Montgomery is day-to-day with left wrist soreness. He missed Thursday's game after he was hit by a pitch Wednesday against Cleveland and is receiving treatment.
"We'll see," White Sox manager Will Venable said of Montgomery's availability. "I can't really predict how he's going to respond to the treatment, but the hope is that he does respond well, and we'll see where he's at (Friday)."
The White Sox improved to 7-3 against Detroit with the win to clinch the season series. They are 29-17 against American League Central teams.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Engineers India expects gains from Middle East plans to bypass Hormuz
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Engineers India on Friday said it expects to benefit from major Middle Eastern clients' plans to invest in infrastructure to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, the vital energy waterway that has been largely shut since the start of the Iran war.
items.body:
Engineers India (ENGI.NS) on Friday said it expects to benefit from major Middle Eastern clients' plans to invest in infrastructure to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, the vital energy waterway that has been [USN:L1N45A02D TEXT:"largely shut"] since the start of the Iran war.
Here are some details from a press conference:
The state-run engineering and consultancy company is in talks with the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia, which are planning to build oil facilities including pipelines, oil terminals and marine infrastructure to bypass the strait, said Chairman Atul Gupta after the company's annual shareholder meeting.
"There has been a slowdown in order inflows from the region... Definitely the conflict has opened more opportunities for us," said Gupta.
He said the company's current order book of 170 billion rupees ($1.77 billion) will expand as the situation in the Middle East improves.
The UAE is planning to build more underground oil storage facilities at Fujairah, Gupta said.
Engineers India opened an office in Saudi Arabia in February and already has a branch in the UAE.
($1 = 95.8725 Indian rupees)

items.title: Ronaldo included in Jesus' first Portugal squad
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been included in new Portugal manager Jorge Jesus' first 25-man squad for the defending champions' upcoming four Nations League matches.
items.body:
Cristiano Ronaldo has been included in new Portugal manager Jorge Jesus' first 25-man squad for the defending champions' upcoming four Nations League matches.
In August, Ronaldo [USN:L6N44D047 TEXT:"fuelled speculation"] about his retirement plans after saying the coming year would probably be the last of his playing career.
The 41-year-old Portugal captain is one of the most decorated players in soccer history, having won major trophies with Manchester United, Real Madrid, Juventus and current club Al-Nassr since making his senior debut for Sporting in 2002.
Ronaldo, a five-time Ballon d'Or winner, was unable to add a World Cup title to his list of honours after [USN:L8N4381RF TEXT:"Portugal were knocked out"] in the last 16 by [USN:L6N43L0A9 TEXT:"eventual champions Spain"], leaving the sport's biggest prize absent from his trophy cabinet.
Ronaldo confirmed in July that the 2026 World Cup would be [USN:L6N43817K TEXT:"his last"], but he was unwilling to make a hasty call on his international future.
"His performance is what matters. The past doesn't count," Jorge Jesus told a press conference on Friday.
"In this squad, there are 13 players who have worked with me. I don't have a set core, so within this group, there were several players who were important for this squad.
"Cris is a player like any other. If he performs, he plays; if not, he doesn't. He has a different status - he has five Ballon d'Or awards - but does that factor into my decisions? No. However, the fact that he is different is."
Jesus will make his debut as Portugal manager against Wales at home on September 24. Portugal then travel to face Norway and Denmark on September 27 and October 1 respectively, before hosting Norway on October 4.
[USN:L6N43C0SF TEXT:"Portugal appointed the 72-year-old"] former Al-Nassr boss in July, days after Spaniard Roberto [USN:L6N43816J TEXT:"Martinez stepped down"] following the country's World Cup exit.

items.title: 'Call Dangote, we need a board meeting': Nigerian refinery IPO sparks meme frenzy
items.author: Macdonald Dzirutwe
items.creator: Macdonald Dzirutwe
items.summary: A rush by Nigerians to buy shares in Aliko Dangote's petroleum refinery is fuelling a wave of viral memes portraying even the smallest investors as newly minted captains of industry and personal advisers to Africa's richest man.
items.body:
A rush by Nigerians to [USN:L1N456052 TEXT:"buy shares"] in Aliko Dangote's petroleum refinery is fuelling a wave of viral memes portraying even the smallest investors as newly minted captains of industry and personal advisers to Africa's richest man.

View this post on Instagram

The refinery's initial public offering — the continent's biggest ever — opened to retail investors on Monday. It allowed Nigerians to buy as few as 10 shares for $4, a low entry threshold that has helped turn the share sale into a cultural moment extending well beyond financial circles.
"Please, who has house for rent close to Dangote refinery in Lagos," one X user wrote . "I just bought Dangote IPO and I need to be seeing whatever is happening in our company 24/7 starting from tomorrow."
Neither Dangote nor the underwriters have disclosed demand figures, but [USN:L8N45710L TEXT:"digital investment platforms"] suffered outages as people rushed to subscribe on the first day.
The memes offer a glimpse into how ordinary Nigerians are engaging with what has been marketed as a [USN:L8N4530UY TEXT:""people's IPO""].
'WE ARE TOGETHER IN THIS NOW' Rather than debating valuations or future earnings, many are embracing the symbolism of owning a stake in one of Africa's biggest industrial projects, joking that a modest investment has made them refinery co-owners, board members and business partners of Dangote himself.
One widely shared video shows a new shareholder complaining about the dirty state of a Dangote fuel tanker truck parked on the side of the road and its absent driver.
"Dangote, we need a board meeting. We need to talk," the investor said.
Others posted mock Dangote Refinery ownership certificates, bearing their portraits with titles like "chief investment officer" or "co-founder and partner".
Some memes show people pretending to check on refinery performance or video-call the billionaire owner to discuss "our refinery".
Popular comedian Sabinus has posted skits portraying new investors as overbearing owners demanding updates from refinery management moments after purchasing just a few dollars' worth of shares.
"We are together in this now," one says in a clip, as he calls for an operational briefing, insisting investors deserved regular reports.
Other comedians and content creators have riffed on similar themes, depicting first-time shareholders directing refinery staff, approving business decisions and calling emergency meetings over minor issues.
Behind the humour lies genuine enthusiasm for a landmark offer that could broaden participation in Nigeria's capital markets.
While most investors know their tiny stakes confer little influence, the memes reflect a rare moment when share ownership has captured the public imagination.

items.title: Ex-capitão Ryan fica de fora da convocação da Austrália para amistosos contra o Brasil
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O técnico da Austrália, Tony Popovic, deixou de fora da convocação o ex-capitão Mathew Ryan, com 105 partidas pela seleção, para os amistosos contra o Brasil em Townsville e Brisbane no final deste mês — os últimos jogos da Austrália em casa antes da Copa da Ásia, no início do próximo ano.
items.body:
O técnico da Austrália, Tony Popovic, deixou de fora da convocação o ex-capitão Mathew Ryan, com 105 partidas pela seleção, para os amistosos contra o Brasil em Townsville e Brisbane no final deste mês — os últimos jogos da Austrália em casa antes da Copa da Ásia, no início do próximo ano.
Ryan, de 34 anos, participou da Copa do Mundo deste ano como capitão e goleiro titular, mas foi substituído por Patrick Beach e entrou em campo apenas como reserva na disputa de pênaltis, quando a Austrália foi derrotada pelo Egito nas oitavas de final.
A convocação de 26 jogadores inclui Beach e outros 15 que participaram da campanha na Copa do Mundo, além de sete jogadores que ainda não estrearam pela seleção. Jordan Bos, Cristian Volpato e Cameron Burgess ficaram de fora devido a lesões.
Os meio-campistas Riley McGree e Patrick Yazbek foram convocados novamente após não disputarem a Copa do Mundo devido a lesões.
A Austrália enfrenta o Brasil, pentacampeão mundial, em Townsville no dia 25 de setembro e novamente em Brisbane quatro dias depois. A equipe também disputará amistosos fora de casa contra o Catar e a Jordânia antes da Copa da Ásia, que acontecerá de 7 de janeiro a 5 de fevereiro na Arábia Saudita.
“Escolhemos um elenco de olho na Copa Asiática de 2027 e no futuro, e é uma grande oportunidade para continuarmos crescendo como equipe”, disse Popovic.

Defensores: Kealey Adamson, Aziz Behich, Kasey Bos, Alessandro Circati, Milos Degenek, Jason Geria, Lucas Herrington, Jacob Italiano, Dylan Leonard e Harry Souttar
Meio-campistas: Jackson Irvine, Riley McGree, Connor Metcalfe, Aiden O’Neill, Paul Okon-Engstler, Alexander Robertson e Patrick Yazbek
Atacantes: Eli Adams, Yaya Dukuly, Nestory Irankunda, Mohamed Toure, Tete Yengi e Marcus Younis

items.title: EXCLUSIVE China Rare Earth Group in talks to buy MP Materials shareholder Shenghe Resources, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: State-owned China Rare Earth Group is in talks to acquire Shenghe Resources , said two sources with knowledge of the matter, a move that would consolidate Beijing's control over the sector and give the firm a stake in one of Washington's rare earth plays.
items.body:
State-owned China Rare Earth Group is in talks to acquire Shenghe Resources (600392.SS) , said two sources with knowledge of the matter, a move that would consolidate Beijing's control over the sector and give the firm a stake in one of Washington's rare earth plays.
If successful, the deal would hand over control of Shenghe's stakes in foreign firms, including a 3% share of US rare earths company MP Materials (MP.N) , which counts the US Department of Defense as its largest shareholder after [USN:L4N3T70RF TEXT:"an investment last year"].
Talks between the two companies have been underway since earlier this year, said the sources who spoke on the condition of anonymity given the sensitivity of the matter. China Rare Earth Group wants to take a controlling stake, one of the people said.
The sources did not know when the acquisition would be announced or completed.
An acquisition would give China Rare Earth control over one of the last leading Chinese companies in rare earth mining and refining with some private ownership, bringing to a close [USN:L4N3SF0HY TEXT:"a decades-long push"] to consolidate the sector under state control.
It would also give Beijing tighter control over elements that are vital to electric vehicles, wind turbines, electronics and the defense sector. It has [USN:L3N3S60J7 TEXT:"wielded this control to great effect"] in its trade war with the US.
Last year, Shenghe [USN:L6N3V305J TEXT:"acquired"] Australia's Peak Rare Earths.
It is not clear how the prospect of a major Chinese state-owned rare earth firm sharing space on a shareholder registry with the US Department of Defense could impact the deal. The sources did not know what would happen to Shenghe's overseas assets and stakes.
MP has repeatedly said neither Shenghe nor the Chinese government has any control over its operations.
China Rare Earth Group, Shenghe Resources and the Ministry of Commerce did not respond to requests for comment.
A deal would also grant Shenghe better access to quotas that Beijing typically uses to control supply, according to one of the sources. Beijing grants those quotas to state-run companies and then the quotas are allocated to subsidiaries.
The quotas for mining, smelting and separation are closely monitored as a barometer for global rare earths supply, but China has [USN:L4N3TE0SV TEXT:"held back"] from publicly disclosing them.
China Rare Earth Group, set up in 2021 after reorganizing five state-run rare-earths-related companies, is the country's largest supplier of heavy rare earth elements.

items.title: Polícia espanhola lança operação para retirar imigrantes da praia de Ceuta
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A polícia de choque espanhola disparou balas de borracha para o ar e agrediu pessoas com cassetetes na sexta-feira, ao iniciar uma operação para retirar milhares de imigrantes das praias do enclave norte-africano de Ceuta e transferir alguns deles para alojamentos temporários.
items.body:
A polícia de choque espanhola disparou balas de borracha para o ar e agrediu pessoas com cassetetes na sexta-feira, ao iniciar uma operação para retirar milhares de imigrantes das praias do enclave norte-africano de Ceuta e transferir alguns deles para alojamentos temporários.
A Espanha estima que 10 mil imigrantes permaneçam no pequeno território. Mais de 72 mil cruzaram a fronteira vindo de Marrocos no final de julho, em uma onda de chegadas sem precedentes, embora a maioria tenha partido posteriormente.
Autoridades construíram novos alojamentos temporários dentro do porto do enclave para abrigar 1.700 pessoas. ONGs afirmam que milhares continuam sem moradia e têm dormido ao relento em acampamentos.
A operação para esvaziar as praias começou na sexta-feira, pouco antes das 7h, horário local, e contou com a participação da polícia de choque e das Forças Armadas espanholas.
Imigrantes que passaram a noite esperando na praia na esperança de conseguir uma vaga no abrigo temporário inicialmente aplaudiram quando a marcha começou, mas depois surgiram confusões enquanto disputavam o número limitado de vagas disponíveis.
Imagens da emissora estatal TVE mostraram aglomeração e empurrões enquanto as pessoas lutavam para entrar na rota designada. A polícia disparou balas de borracha para o ar e atingiu vários imigrantes com cassetetes antes que a situação se acalmasse e a operação fosse retomada.
Imagens posteriores mostraram principalmente homens adultos carregando seus pertences, caminhando em pequenos grupos sob escolta policial ao longo de um trajeto de pouco mais de 1 km da praia de El Trampolín até o porto.
A grande maioria dos imigrantes é de homens e meninos. Alojamentos temporários foram construídos apenas para homens adultos, de modo que os menores estão sendo separados e acomodados em locais distintos.
Três líderes de ONGs disseram à Reuters que as autoridades demoraram demais para fornecer aos imigrantes o abrigo mínimo exigido pelo pacto europeu de migração e que os centros de acolhimento abertos até o momento não tinham capacidade para acomodar aqueles que ainda dormiam nas ruas.
Uma ONG estimou que cerca de 4.000 miigrantes permaneciam ao ar livre nas praias e calçadas de Ceuta, o que significa que o novo centro não seria suficiente para desocupar os acampamentos improvisados em áreas públicas. Dois líderes de ONGs afirmaram que as autoridades provavelmente esperam que a maioria dos imigrantes retorne voluntariamente ao Marrocos.

items.title: Egipcio deportado por EEUU a Guinea Ecuatorial lleva una semana recluido e incomunicado, según abogado
items.author: Robbie Corey-Boulet
items.creator: Robbie Corey-Boulet
items.summary: Un ciudadano egipcio deportado de Estados Unidos a Guinea Ecuatorial, que había criticado la actuación de las fuerzas de seguridad de ese país, lleva una semana detenido en una comisaría de la gendarmería, según dijo uno de sus abogados.
items.body:
Un ciudadano egipcio deportado de Estados Unidos a Guinea Ecuatorial, que había criticado la actuación de las fuerzas de seguridad de ese país, lleva una semana detenido en una comisaría de la gendarmería, según dijo uno de sus abogados.
Ahmed Soliman fue detenido el viernes de la semana pasada y no ha podido reunirse con sus abogados, según declaró a Reuters el letrado, que habló bajo condición de anonimato.
Ni el portavoz del Gobierno de este país centroafricano ni su embajada en Washington respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios.
UN VIDEO MUESTRA UN ALTERCADO EN UN HOTEL A principios de este mes, Soliman afirmó que unos agentes de policía les apuntaron con armas a él y a otros migrantes durante un altercado en un hotel de Malabo, la antigua capital, donde él y otros migrantes deportados por Estados Unidos han permanecido retenidos.
El vIdeo del incidente y la noticia de la posterior detención de Soliman provocaron nuevas críticas por parte de grupos defensores de los derechos humanos hacia los denominados acuerdos de deportación a terceros países que la Administración Trump ha firmado con varios países africanos.
Estos acuerdos permiten a Washington deportar a migrantes que no pueden ser enviados legalmente a sus países de origen porque obtuvieron protección de los jueces de inmigración estadounidenses.
Washington ha defendido los acuerdos de terceros países como legales y ha afirmado que las deportaciones se llevan a cabo de conformidad con la legislación estadounidense en materia de inmigración.
Soliman se encontraba detenido en la comisaría de la gendarmería de La Luna, en Malabo, según informó su abogado.
Según organizaciones de derechos humanos, entre ellas Amnistía Internacional, estas instalaciones se han utilizado en el pasado para retener a activistas de derechos humanos.
DETENIDOS ESTÁN ACUSADOS DE ROMPER UN ESPEJO, SEGÚN AMNISTÍA Soliman había sido acusado de romper un espejo en un ascensor del hotel, aunque eso fue un pretexto para su detención, según el abogado.
"Estamos seguros de que se trató de una represalia por las declaraciones de Ahmed y por la filtración de los videos", afirmó el abogado, refiriéndose a las imágenes en las que se veía a las fuerzas de seguridad apuntando con armas a los deportados.
Amnistía Internacional afirmó en un comunicado el viernes que Soliman se encontraba detenido junto con otro deportado, Samson Birhane, y que ambos estaban acusados de romper el espejo.
"Las autoridades deben ponerlos en libertad de inmediato, informarles de los cargos que se les imputan y permitirles el acceso sin trabas a un abogado", señaló.
El portavoz del Gobierno de Guinea Ecuatorial y su embajada en Estados Unidos no han emitido ningún comunicado sobre el caso de Soliman.

items.title: Putin envoy and far-right AfD prepare talks to get Russian gas back for Germany, sources say
items.author: John O'Donnell
items.creator: John O'Donnell
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin's top economic envoy and Germany's far-right AfD leadership have begun preparations to meet next year to discuss restarting gas supplies to Europe's biggest economy, two people familiar with the plan said.
items.body:
Russian President Vladimir Putin's top economic envoy and Germany's far-right AfD leadership have begun preparations to meet next year to discuss restarting gas supplies to Europe's biggest economy, two people familiar with the plan said.
The discussions for a meeting as early as March underline the close relations between Moscow and the AfD, which, although blocked from power by a coalition of its rivals, is Germany's most [USN:L1N43601E TEXT:"popular party with voters"].
The meeting would be attended by Kirill Dmitriev, who is a close adviser to Putin and who heads Russia's sovereign wealth fund, as well as AfD co-leaders Alice Weidel and Tino Chrupalla, one of the people said.
A spokesperson for the AfD and a representative for Dmitriev declined to comment.
Before the sanctions imposed over Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 , Russia supplied more than a third of Germany's crude oil imports and more than half of its natural gas.
The meeting would only happen if a peace framework was agreed first between Russia and Ukraine, and the organisers hoped it would bring together the AfD, Russia and the United States, the person said. Possible locations for the summit included Israel, the United Arab Emirates or India, they added.
Weidel [USN:L8N43103Q TEXT:"advocated the end of a boycott of Russian oil and gas"] to bolster Germany's flagging economy in an interview with Reuters in June.
Dmitriev was present at a meeting this month in Moscow with US representatives Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
Organisers hoped Witkoff and Kushner would also attend the gas meeting, which would examine reopening the Russian Nord Stream gas pipelines, said the person.
A senior US official told Reuters that Witkoff and Kushner have not been informed about or invited to the proposed summit.
AfD HOPES TO SCORE WITH VOTERS
Any gathering would be symbolic, since the AfD does not govern. But the preparations highlight the fragility of Germany's political system, where the longstanding refusal of mainstream parties to work with the far-right is being tested by the AfD's electoral success.
The AfD has [USN:L1N44Y01V TEXT:"just won a major victory"] to become the biggest party in a state election in Saxony-Anhalt, and [USN:L8N43H14M TEXT:"faces another test"] of its popularity on Sunday in an election in the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. The Russian Nord Stream gas pipelines enter Germany in this state.
The American Chamber of Commerce in Moscow welcomed the idea as "a positive and timely step".
"Involving Germany as a key European economy can create a broader platform for discussing issues that are significant both for these countries and for the rest of the world," said Robert Agee, President of AmCham Russia.
Germany has struggled to recover from the shock caused by the shutdown of the key undersea Nord Stream pipelines, some of which were crippled by explosions in September 2022.
But any effort to restart Russian gas supplies or Nord Stream would stoke fierce resistance, both in Germany and among its allies, particularly in Eastern Europe.
"Germany cannot become dependent on Russia again," said Michael Kellner, a Green lawmaker who was in charge of German energy policy in government during the crisis triggered by the cut-off of Russian gas following its invasion of Ukraine.
"We cannot repeat the mistakes of the energy crisis," he said. "It cost us €50 billion. We cannot want to go back to that. It would be treason. Putin is using the AfD to his own ends."
Roderich Kiesewetter, a member of parliament from Chancellor Friedrich Merz's Christian Democrats, said the AfD meeting could embolden those in his party who also favoured buying Russian gas.
"The AfD is on Russia's side, willing to betray both the Ukraine and Germany. Russia uses energy, especially Nord Stream, as a hybrid weapon for military purposes. Reopening Nord Stream would be a disaster for European security and isolate Germany."
The AfD has framed its call for a resumption of Russian gas supplies as pragmatic, with Weidel describing "cheap energy from Russia" as "the secret of the success of 'Made in Germany'."
The AfD hopes the meeting can illustrate their competence in foreign policy and show up the government for inaction in tackling high energy prices, said one of the sources.
Germany's support for Ukraine has become increasingly divisive.
The country's relationship with Russia carries more weight in the east, which was under Soviet rule until the fall of the Berlin Wall more than 35 years ago. Many there take a sympathetic stance towards Russia and a critical view of Germany's military protector, the United States.

items.title: Zealand Pharma's short bowel syndrome drug wins backing from EU panel
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Zealand Pharma received a positive opinion from the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommending approval of its drug candidate Zeydovio for the treatment of short bowel syndrome, the Danish company said on Friday.
items.body:
Zealand Pharma (ZELA.CO) received a positive opinion from the Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommending approval of its drug candidate Zeydovio for the treatment of short bowel syndrome, the Danish company said on Friday.
The positive opinion marks the first major advancement in short bowel syndrome treatment in Europe in more than a decade, the drugmaker added.
The long-acting GLP-2 analogue glepaglutide cut patients' need for parenteral support in a late-stage trial, with 65.7% of patients achieving at least a 20% reduction versus 38.9% on placebo.
One in seven patients on the twice-weekly dose came off the nutrition and fluid support entirely after 24 weeks of treatment, Zealand Pharma said.
The company will now step up talks to find a global commercial partner responsible for the drug's launch in Europe and the US, CEO Adam Steensberg said.
The European Commission will now review the opinion, with a final decision on the drug's marketing authorization expected within about 67 days.
Zealand Pharma is enrolling patients in another late-stage trial to support a US New Drug Application for the drug.

items.title: British home price increases to lag inflation this year and next
items.author: Jonathan Cable
items.creator: Jonathan Cable
items.summary: British home prices will rise less than previously expected, achieving just 1.3% gains this year as a challenging economic environment stops people from moving while those renting properties will face steeper increases, a Reuters poll found.
items.body:
British home prices will rise less than previously expected, achieving just 1.3% gains this year as a challenging economic environment stops people from moving while those renting properties will face steeper increases, a Reuters poll found.
Next year the average cost of buying a home will increase 2.0% while in 2028 it will rise 3.3%, according to median forecasts in the September 7 to 18 poll of 16 property market experts. Forecasts for 2027 ranged from no change to a 3.5% rise.
A June survey had predicted a 1.8% rise this year and 3.0% in both next year and 2028.
"Elevated mortgage rates and a lack of stimulus mean we expect prices will remain broadly flat. We could see some modest increases in prices start to appear in 2027," Marcus Dixon at JLL said.
The [USN:L8N4590W3 TEXT:"Bank of England"] left borrowing costs unchanged on Thursday but Governor Andrew Bailey explicitly warned that prolonged conflict in the Middle East may require tighter policy.
On Wednesday the [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"US Federal Reserve"] lifted its key interest rate and flagged more hikes were to come as did the [USN:L1N452054 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] last week.
Britain's overall [USN:L8N45806W TEXT:"inflation"] accelerated to a five-month high of 3.1% in August, official figures showed on Wednesday. It was expected to average 3.1% this year before dropping to 2.5% in 2027 and 1.9% in 2028, a separate [USN:L6N4500E1 TEXT:"Reuters poll"] showed.
Signalling a lack of desire to move, lenders approved the fewest [USN:L8N44T0LI TEXT:"mortgages"] for house purchase since January 2024 in July, according to BoE data at the start of this month.
A slowdown in the [USN:S8N42Q0CN TEXT:"housing market"] appears to be levelling off as measures of buyer demand and agreed sales moved away from recent lows, the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors said earlier this month.
But [USN:L6N4580B3 TEXT:"Barratt Redrow"] — the country's biggest homebuilder — lowered its home completions target on Wednesday, echoing wider strains as planning bottlenecks and cautious buyers weigh on the sector.
In London, prices will fall 1.4% this year before recouping some of those losses and rising 0.9% in 2027, the poll found. Those forecasts were also weaker than June's survey.
The average price of a home in London was £646,451 ($864,176) in August, according to the latest house price index published by Rightmove, making buying a property out of reach for many — especially first-time buyers.
RENTERS Nationwide rental prices will rise 3.0% this year and next. They will increase 2.8% in 2028, the poll said.
"Fewer landlords are letting out property, shrinking rental supply. At the same time, high borrowing costs are pricing many would-be buyers out of the market, pushing them into renting instead," Liam Daly at CEBR said.
"Together, these trends point to strong rental price growth ahead."
Average private [USN:S8N41006T TEXT:"rent prices"] rose last month at the fastest rate this year, according to official data on Wednesday which also showed a cooling in house price inflation.
([USN:L6N44P06K TEXT:"Other stories"] from the Q3 Reuters housing market polls)
($1 = £0.7481)
